classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You can increase one ability score by 2, or you can increase two ability scores by 1. You can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

classFeature.name: Slow Fall
entries: You can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} when you fall to reduce any falling damage you take by an amount equal to five times your monk level.

classFeature.name: Extra Attack
entries: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action on your turn.

classFeature.name: Stunning Strike
entries: You can interfere with an opponent's body. When you hit another creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can spend 1 focus point to attempt a stunning strike. The target must succeed on a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or be {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned} until the end of your next turn.

classFeature.name: Enhanced Strikes
entries: Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} count as enhanced for the purpose of overcoming {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} and immunity to unenhanced attacks and damage.

classFeature.name: Evasion
entries: Your instinctive agility lets you dodge out of the way of certain area effects. When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, and only half damage if you fail.

classFeature.name: Stillness of Mind
entries: You can use your action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to end one effect on yourself that is causing you to be {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} or {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb}.

classFeature.name: Purity of Body
entries: You are immune to disease and {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} and resistant to {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} damage.

classFeature.name: Diamond Soul
entries: Your mastery of focus grants you proficiency in all {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}, and when you fail a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can spend 1 focus point to reroll it, taking the new roll.

classFeature.name: Timeless Vessel
entries: Your focus sustains you so that you suffer none of the frailty of old age, and you can't be aged abnormally. You can still die of old age, however. Additionally, when you complete a {@variantrule Short Rest|sw5e-phb|short rest}, you can expend a Hit Die to remove 1 level of {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} or {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed}.

classFeature.name: Empty Body
entries: You can use your action to spend 4 focus points to become {@condition Invisible|sw5e-phb|invisible} for 1 minute. During that time, you also have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to all damage but force damage.

classFeature.name: Perfect Self
entries: You've gained perfect control over your body. Your Dexterity and Wisdom or Charisma scores (your choice) increase by 2. Your maximum for those scores increases by 2. Additionally, when you roll for {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} and have fewer than 6 focus points remaining, you regain up to 6 focus points.

classFeature.name: Monastic Vows
entries: The vows are presented in alphabetical order.

entries.name: Vow of Deflection
entries: You can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to divert a strike when you are dealt damage by a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}. When you do so, the damage taken by the attack is reduced by 1d10 + your Dexterity modifier + your monk level.

entries.name: Vow of the Devoted
entries: You gain a limited ability to manipulate the Force. See {@book chapter 10|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} for the general rules of {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} and {@book chapter 11|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} for the {@book force powers list|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

{@b {@i Force Powers Known.}} You learn 2 {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of your choice. You learn an additional power at 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th, 11th, 13th, 15th, and 17th level. You may not learn a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of a level higher than your Max Power Level, and you may learn a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} at the same time you learn its prerequisite. You may only learn {@book universal powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} in this way.

{@b {@i Force Points.}} Rather than force points, powers you learn through this vow are cast using your focus points, at 1 focus point per power level. You may only cast {@book universal powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} in this way.

{@b {@i Max Power Level.}} Many {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} can be overpowered, consuming more focus points to create a greater effect. You can overpower these abilities to a maximum level, which increases at higher levels. Your Max Power Level is 1st. It increases to 2nd at 7th level, 3rd at 13th level, and 4th at 17th level. You may only cast {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} at 4th-level once. You regain the ability to do so after a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

{@b {@i Forcecasting Ability.}} You use your focus ability whenever a power refers to your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability}. If a power you cast with focus points calls for a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you use your focus save DC. If a power you cast with focus points calls for an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, you use your focus attack modifier.

entries.name: Vow of Fate
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level} When you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, roll a {@dice d20} and record the number rolled. Once before your next short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can replace any {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, or {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} made by you or a creature within 5 feet of you with this roll. You must choose to do so before the roll.

entries.name: Vow of the Fighter
entries: You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one of the fighting Style options, detailed in {@book chapter 6|sw5e-phb|6}.

entries.name: Vow of the Focused
entries: You can substitute Strength, Constitution, or Intelligence (chosen when you take this vow) for Wisdom or Charisma for your monk class features, except for other vows and Monastic Tradition features.

entries.name: Vow of Fortitude
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level} You can use your action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to end one effect on yourself that is causing you to be {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded} or {@condition Deafened|sw5e-phb|deafened}.

entries.name: Vow of Freedom
entries: You ignore unenhanced {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain}, and when you would use your action to break free of an effect that is grappling or restraining you, you can instead use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Vow of Intuition
entries: You can no longer have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against creatures within 10 feet of you due to not being able to see them.

entries.name: Vow of the Limber
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level} When you make your first unarmed strike on your turn, you can choose to spend 1 focus point. If you do so, your reach with your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} increases by 5 feet until the end of your turn.

entries.name: Vow of the Nemesis
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 13th level} As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can choose one creature within 30 feet that you can see. The creature must make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your focus save DC. On a successful save, the creature becomes immune to this feature for 24 hours. On a failed save, for the next minute, the creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against creatures other than you, and it must make an additional Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} each time it attempts to move to a space that is more than 30 feet away from you; if it succeeds on this {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, this feature doesn't restrict its movement for that turn.

This feature ends early if you attack another creature, if you target another hostile creature with a power or class feature, if a friendly creature damages the target, if a friendly creature targets it with a power or class feature, or if you target another creature with this feature.

entries.name: Vow of the Open Mind
entries: You gain proficiency in a skill of your choice. Additionally, you can spend 1 focus point and 10 minutes meditating on a skill in which you are proficient. If you do so, when you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} with the chosen skill, you can add your Wisdom or Charisma modifier to the check. You can only have one instance of this feature active at a time.

entries.name: Vow of Precision
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 13th level} Your {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} range with {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} increases by 1.

entries.name: Vow of Requital
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 13th level} When you take the {@action Dodge|sw5e-phb} action and an attack made by a creature within 5 feet of you misses you before the start of your next turn, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to make one {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} with a monk weapon or unarmed strike against that creature.

entries.name: Vow of Restoration
entries: When you would make an unarmed strike, you can spend 1 focus point to instead touch a willing creature within your reach. Roll your Martial Arts die. The target gains {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the amount rolled + your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of +1).

entries.name: Vow of the Sentry
entries: You gain proficiency in light and {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor}. Additionally, you can now gain the benefits of your Martial Arts and Unarmored Movement features while wearing light or {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor} as long as you are not wielding a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}.

entries.name: Vow of Serenity
entries: Your maximum focus increases by an amount equal to half your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of +1).

entries.name: Vow of Spirit
entries: You can use your choice of Wisdom or Charisma instead of Strength or Dexterity for the attack and damage rolls of your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} and monk weapons. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

entries.name: Vow of the Versatile
entries: When you would make an unarmed strike as part of your Martial Arts {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} attack or your Flurry of Blows, you can instead make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} with a monk weapon you are wielding, using your Martial Arts die in place of the weapon's damage.

classFeature.name: Monastic Orders
entries: At 3rd level, you choose a monastic order that you emulate. Your choice grants features at 3rd level and again at 7th, 10th, 15th, and 18th level.

classFeature.name: Monastic Orders feature
entries: At 6th level, you gain a feature granted by your monastic orders.

classFeature.name: Monastic Orders feature
entries: At 11th level, you gain a feature granted by your monastic orders.

classFeature.name: Monastic Orders feature
entries: At 17th level, you gain a feature granted by your monastic orders.

classFeature.name: Expertise
entries: Choose two of your skill proficiencies, or one of skill proficiencies and one of your tool proficiencies, or two of your tool proficiencies. You gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in those skills or tools.
At 6th level, you can choose two more of your proficiencies (in skills or tools) to gain this benefit.

classFeature.name: Expertise
entries: Choose two of your skill proficiencies, or one of skill proficiencies and one of your tool proficiencies, or two of your tool proficiencies. You gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in those skills or tools.
At 6th level, you can choose two more of your proficiencies (in skills or tools) to gain this benefit.

classFeature.name: Sneak Attack
entries: You know how to strike subtly and exploit a foe's distraction. Once per turn, you can deal an extra 1d6 damage to one creature you hit with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} if you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}. This damage is the same as the weapon's damage, and the attack must use a finesse or a ranged weapon.

You don't need {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} if another enemy of the target is within 5 feet of it, that enemy isn't {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb}, and you don't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}.
The amount of the extra damage increases as you gain levels in this class, as shown in the Sneak Attack column of the operative table.

classFeature.name: Cunning Action
entries: Your quick thinking and agility allow you to move and act quickly. You can take the {@action Dash|sw5e-phb}, {@action Disengage|sw5e-phb}, or {@action Hide|sw5e-phb} actions as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.

classFeature.name: Operative Exploits
entries: You've adopted two exploits, as detailed at the end of the class description. You adopt an additional exploit at 7th, 13th, and 17th level.

classFeature.name: Bad Feeling
entries: You have a wary eye, bordering on paranoia. When you roll for {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative}, you can move up to your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. This movement happens before the {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} order is determined.
Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

classFeature.name: Operative Practice
entries: You choose a practice that you emulate in the exercise of your operative abilities, which is detailed at the end of the class description. Your practice choice grants you features at 3rd level and then again at 9th, 13th, and 17th level.

classFeature.name: Operative Practice
entries: You choose a practice that you emulate in the exercise of your operative abilities, which is detailed at the end of the class description. Your practice choice grants you features at 3rd level and then again at 9th, 13th, and 17th level.

classFeature.name: Operative Practice
entries: You choose a practice that you emulate in the exercise of your operative abilities, which is detailed at the end of the class description. Your practice choice grants you features at 3rd level and then again at 9th, 13th, and 17th level.

classFeature.name: Operative Practice
entries: You choose a practice that you emulate in the exercise of your operative abilities, which is detailed at the end of the class description. Your practice choice grants you features at 3rd level and then again at 9th, 13th, and 17th level.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You can increase one ability score by 2, or you can increase two ability scores by 1. You can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You can increase one ability score by 2, or you can increase two ability scores by 1. You can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You can increase one ability score by 2, or you can increase two ability scores by 1. You can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You can increase one ability score by 2, or you can increase two ability scores by 1. You can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You can increase one ability score by 2, or you can increase two ability scores by 1. You can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You can increase one ability score by 2, or you can increase two ability scores by 1. You can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

classFeature.name: Uncanny Dodge
entries: When an attacker that you can see deals damage to you with an attack, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to halve the attack's damage against you.

classFeature.name: Evasion
entries: When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, and only half damage if you fail.

classFeature.name: Reliable Talent
entries: You have refined your chosen skills until they approach perfection. Ability checks you make that let you add your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} gain a minimum roll threshold, discussed in chapter 7.

classFeature.name: Blindsense
entries: If you are able to hear, you are aware of the location of any hidden or {@condition Invisible|sw5e-phb|invisible} creature within 10 feet of you.

classFeature.name: Slippery Mind
entries: You have acquired greater mental strength. You gain proficiency in Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}.

classFeature.name: Elusive
entries: You are so evasive that attackers rarely gain the upper hand against you. No {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} against you while you aren't {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb}.

classFeature.name: Stroke of Luck
entries: You have an uncanny knack for succeeding when you need to. Your Dexterity and Intelligence scores increase by 2. Your maximum for those scores increases by 2. Additionally, if your attack misses a target within range, you can turn the miss into a hit. Alternatively, if you fail an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, you can treat the {@dice d20} roll as a 20.
Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

classFeature.name: Operative Exploits
entries: The exploits are presented in alphabetical order.

entries.name: Commander's Exploit
entries: You gain proficiency in {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor}.

entries.name: Explorer's Exploit
entries: You can hold your breath twice as long as you are normally able to, and take half as much damage from fall damage.

entries.name: Fate's Exploit
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level} When you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, roll a {@dice d20} and record the number rolled. Once before your next short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can replace any {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, or {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} made by you or a creature within 5 feet of you with this roll. You must choose to do so before the roll.

entries.name: Fighter's Exploit
entries: You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one of the fighting Style options, detailed in {@book chapter 6|sw5e-phb|6}.

entries.name: Freedom's Exploit
entries: You ignore unenhanced {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain}, and when you would use your action to break free of an effect that is grappling or restraining you, you can instead use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Guerrilla's Exploit
entries: You only need 3 hours of sleep during a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} to gain its benefits, instead of 6. Additionally, if your {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} would be interrupted, you only need to complete the {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} instead of restarting it to gain its benefits. Lastly, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion}.

entries.name: Learner's Exploit
entries: You gain proficiency in a skill and a tool, or two tools.
You can select this exploit multiple times, each time choosing a new skill and a tool, or two new tools.

entries.name: Mentor's Exploit
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 13th level} Once per turn, whenever both you and a friendly creature within 60 feet that can see and hear you both have to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist the same effect, you can choose to have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the save. If you do so, the friendly creature gains {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the save. You can use this feature before or after you both make the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, but you must do so before the GM says whether the save succeeds or fails.

entries.name: Skill's Exploit
entries: You learn an exploit that enhances your ability to apply your knowledge to combat situations. You can take this exploit multiple times.

When you take the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action, you can use one of your skill exploits granted by this feature. You can use these features a combined two times. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain any expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
Choose from the following. You must be proficient in the skill in order to take that skill's exploit.

{@b {@i Aim (Stealth).}} You attempt to line up a strike against a creature you can see that you are hidden from. Make a Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb}) check contested by the target's Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) check. If your check succeeds, you gain a +10 bonus to the first {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} you make against the target before the end of your next turn. If your check fails, you are no longer hidden from the target.

{@b {@i Angle (Perception).}} You attempt to predict the behavior of a humanoid you can see within 30 feet. Make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) check contested by the target's Dexterity ({@skill Sleight Of Hand|sw5e-phb}) check. If your check succeeds, the first {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} the target makes before the start of your next turn has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}, and the first {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} the creature makes before the start of your next turn has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}. If your check fails, you can't use this feature on this target again for 1 hour.

{@b {@i Battle Cry (Intimidation).}} You attempt to demoralize one humanoid you can see within 30 feet of you that can see and hear you. Make a Charisma ({@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb}) check contested by the target's Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) check. If your check succeeds, the target is {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb} until the end of your next turn. If the target was already {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb} of you, it must immediately drop whatever it is holding. On its next turn, if it is still {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb} of you, it must take the {@action Dash|sw5e-phb} action and move away from you by the safest available route on its turn, unless there is nowhere to move. If your check fails, you can't use this feature on this target again for 1 hour.

{@b {@i Charm (Persuasion).}} You attempt to convince one humanoid you can see within 30 feet that can hear and understand you. Make a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}) check contested by the target's Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) check. If you have dealt damage to the creature in the last hour, it has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the check. If your check succeeds, the target is {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} by you until the start of your next turn, and it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the first {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} it makes against a creature before the end of its next turn. If your check fails, you can't use this feature on this target again for 1 hour.

{@b {@i Confuse Beast (Animal Handling).}} You attempt to confuse one beast on the battlefield. Make a Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling|sw5e-phb}) check contested by the target's Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) check. If your check succeeds, the beast cannot take actions or reactions until the end of your next turn. If your check fails, you can't use this feature on this target again for 1 hour.

{@b {@i Distract (Performance).}} You attempt to distract one beast or humanoid you can see within 30 feet of you that can see and hear you. Make a Charisma ({@skill Performance|sw5e-phb}) check contested by the target's Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) check. If your check succeeds, the next {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} made against the target before the start of its next turn has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}. If your check fails, you can't use this feature on this target again for 1 hour.

{@b {@i Emulate Predator (Nature).}} You attempt to emulate the sounds of a natural predator of a beast or plant you can see within 30 feet. Make an Intelligence ({@skill Nature|sw5e-phb}) check contested by the target's Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) check. If your check succeeds, the target must take the {@action Dash|sw5e-phb} action and move away from you by the safest available route on its turn, unless there is nowhere to move. If your check fails, you can't use this feature on this target again for 1 hour.

{@b {@i Feint (Deception).}} You attempt to divert the attention of a target you can see within 30 feet. Make a Charisma ({@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}) check contested by the target's Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) check. If your check succeeds, the first {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} made against the target before the start of your next turn by someone other than you has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}, and the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the first {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} they make against an effect caused by a creature other than you before the start of your next turn. If your check fails, the target can't be deceived by you in this way for 1 hour.

{@b {@i Hacktivate (Technology).}} You attempt to determine the weaknesses in a droid you can see within 30 feet. Make an Intelligence ({@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}) check contested by the target's Intelligence ({@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}) check. If your check succeeds, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the next {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} you make against the target before the end of your turn, and if you hit, you deal additional damage equal to your Intelligence modifier. If your check fails, you can't use this feature on this target again for 1 hour.

{@b {@i Instruct (Investigation).}} You attempt to find a weakness in your target. Make an Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}) check contested by the target's Charisma ({@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}) check. If your check succeeds, if a friendly creature makes an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} against the target and they can see and hear you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to grant them {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the roll. If you do so, and they hit, they deal additional damage equal to your bonus to {@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb} checks. This damage is the same type as the attack's damage. If your check fails, you can't use this feature on this target again for 1 hour.

{@b {@i Intuit (Insight).}} You attempt to determine the motivations of one humanoid you can see within 30 feet. Make a Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) check contested by the target's Charisma ({@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}) check. If your check succeeds, the target can't have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against you until the end of your next turn. If your check fails, the target instead can't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against you until the end of your next turn.

{@b {@i Pocket Sand (Sleight of Hand).}} You attempt to blind one beast or humanoid you can see within 15 feet of you. Make a Dexterity ({@skill Sleight Of Hand|sw5e-phb}) check contested by the target's Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) check. If your check succeeds, the target is {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded} until the end of your turn. If your check fails, you can't use this feature on this target again for 1 hour.

{@b {@i Precision Strike (Medicine).}} You attempt to strike a pressure point in one humanoid within your reach. Make a Wisdom ({@skill Medicine|sw5e-phb}) check contested by the target's Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|sw5e-phb}) check (the target chooses the ability to use). If your check succeeds, they are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb} until the end of their next turn. If your check fails, you can't use this feature on this target again for 1 hour.

{@b {@i Snare (Survival).}} You attempt to cause a creature within 30 feet of you to stumble. Make a Wisdom ({@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}) check contested by the target's Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) check. If your check succeeds, and the target moves towards you before the start of your next turn, it gains 1 {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} level, and you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to cause it to fall prone. If your check fails, you can't use this feature on this target again for 1 hour.

{@b {@i Spin (Piloting).}} You attempt to confound a piloted construct you can see within 30 feet. Make an Intelligence ({@skill Piloting|sw5e-phb}) check contested by the target's Intelligence ({@skill Piloting|sw5e-phb}) check. If your check succeeds, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against you, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against the target, until the start of your next turn. If your check fails, the target instead has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against you, and you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against the target, until the start of your next turn.

{@b {@i Study (Lore).}} You attempt to anticipate your target's action. Make an Intelligence ({@skill Lore|sw5e-phb}) check contested by the target's Charisma ({@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}) check. If your check succeeds, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the first {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} you make against that creature before the end of your next turn. Alternatively, before the end of your next turn, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to grant {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the first {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} the target makes against you. If your check fails, you instead have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the first {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} you make against that creature before the end of your next turn.

{@b {@i Tumble (Acrobatics).}} You attempt to make a quick {@optfeature Tumble|sw5e-phb|tumble}, immediately moving 10 feet. If you begin or end this movement within a creature's reach, make a Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|sw5e-phb}) check contested by it's Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|sw5e-phb}) check (the target chooses the ability to use). If your check succeeds, this movement does not provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks} from it, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the first {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} you make against it before the end of your turn. If your check fails, you immediately fall prone.

{@b {@i Wrestle (Athletics).}} You attempt to grab and pin a creature within 5 feet of you with at least one free hand. The target must be no more than one size larger than you. Make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) check contested by the target's Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|sw5e-phb}) check (the target chooses the ability to use). If your check succeeds, the target is both {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} and {@condition Restrained|sw5e-phb} by you. If the target stops being {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled}, it also stops being {@condition Restrained|sw5e-phb}. If your check fails, you can't use this feature on this target again for 1 hour.

entries.name: Technologist's Exploit
entries: You learn and can cast one 1st-level {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. Your {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} is Intelligence. You require use of a {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} for this power.
You can select this exploit multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different power.

entries.name: Weaponmaster's Exploit
entries: You gain proficiency in three {@filter blasters|items|firearm=true} or {@filter vibroweapons|items|type=martial weapon} that lack the heavy and strength properties.
You can select this exploit multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose different weapons.

classFeature.name: Operative Practices
entries: At 3rd level, you choose a operative practice that you emulate. Your choice grants features at 3rd level and again at 7th, 10th, 15th, and 18th level.

classFeature.name: Operative Practices feature
entries: At 9th level, you gain a feature granted by your operative practices.

classFeature.name: Operative Practices feature
entries: At 13th level, you gain a feature granted by your operative practices.

classFeature.name: Operative Practices feature
entries: At 17th level, you gain a feature granted by your operative practices.

classFeature.name: Academic Superiority
entries: You learn {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} that are fueled by special dice called {@book superiority dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers}. See {@book chapter 13|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} for the {@book maneuvers list|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers}.

entries.name: Maneuvers Known
entries: You learn one {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} of your choice, and you earn more at higher levels, as shown in the Maneuvers Known column of the scholar table. Many {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} enhance an attack in some way. You can use only one {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} per attack, and you may only use each {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} once per turn.
Each time you learn new {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers}, you can also replace one {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} you know with a different one.

entries.name: Superiority Dice
entries: You have three {@book superiority dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers}, which are d4s, and you earn more at higher levels, as shown in the {@book Superiority Dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} Quantity column of the scholar table. This die changes as you gain scholar levels, as shown in the {@book Superiority Dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} Size column of the scholar table. A superiority die is expended when you use it.
You regain all of your expended {@book superiority dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} when you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Maneuver Ability
entries: Your {@book maneuver ability|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} varies based on the type of the {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} you use. You use Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution for {@book physical maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Physical} (your choice), Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma for {@book mental maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Mental} (your choice), and an ability of your choice for {@book general maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|General}. You use this ability whenever a {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} refers to your {@book maneuver ability|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers}. Additionally, you use this ability modifier when setting the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} DC for a {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} you use.
{@b Maneuver save DC} = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your {@book maneuver ability|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} modifier

classFeature.name: Critical Analysis
entries: You are able to {@spell Analyze|sw5e-phb|analyze} a creature, develop a plan on how to best overcome any potential obstacle, and execute that plan with ruthless efficiency. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on your turn, you can {@spell Analyze|sw5e-phb|analyze} a creature you can see within 60 feet of you. For the next minute, or until you {@spell Analyze|sw5e-phb|analyze} another target, you gain the following benefits:

items: When you {@spell Analyze|sw5e-phb|analyze} a hostile creature, your attack and damage rolls made with weapons with {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property} or {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} weapons against that target may use your Critical Analysis ability modifier, which is Intelligence, instead of Strength or Dexterity. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

When you {@spell Analyze|sw5e-phb|analyze} a friendly creature, the target can end your Critical Analysis on them (no action required) to add your Critical Analysis ability modifier, which is Intelligence, to one {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. Once a friendly creature has benefited from this ability, they can not do so again until they complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

classFeature.name: Discovery
entries: As you adventure, your studies have helped you discover new practices you can apply to your skills. You master two discoveries of your choice. Your discovery options are detailed at the end of the class description. When you gain certain scholar levels, you gain additional discoveries of your choice, as shown in the Discoveries column of the scholar table.
Additionally, when you gain a level in this class, you can choose one of the discoveries you know and replace it with another discovery that you could learn at that level.

classFeature.name: Sage Advice
entries: You can spend 1 minute spreading your knowledge and experience, advising those around you. When you do so, choose a skill or tool you are proficient with and a number of friendly creatures up to your Intelligence modifier within 30 feet of you who can hear you and who can understand you. Once within the next hour, the next time each creature would make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} with the chosen skill or tool, they may add their {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} to the roll if they are not already proficient. A creature may only benefit from this feature once. If a creature is targeted by this feature again before using it, they can choose to retain the first benefit or replace it with the new skill or tool instead.

Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. Starting at 13th level, you regain the ability to use it after you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

classFeature.name: Sage Advice
entries: You can spend 1 minute spreading your knowledge and experience, advising those around you. When you do so, choose a skill or tool you are proficient with and a number of friendly creatures up to your Intelligence modifier within 30 feet of you who can hear you and who can understand you. Once within the next hour, the next time each creature would make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} with the chosen skill or tool, they may add their {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} to the roll if they are not already proficient. A creature may only benefit from this feature once. If a creature is targeted by this feature again before using it, they can choose to retain the first benefit or replace it with the new skill or tool instead.

Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. Starting at 13th level, you regain the ability to use it after you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

classFeature.name: Expertise
entries: Choose two of your skill proficiencies, or one of skill proficiencies and one of your tool proficiencies, or two of your tool proficiencies. You gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in those skills or tools.
At 10th level, you can choose another two proficiencies (in skills or tools) to gain this benefit.

At 10th level, you can choose another two proficiencies (in skills or tools) to gain this benefit.

classFeature.name: Academic Pursuit
entries: You dedicate your studies towards a pursuit, which is detailed at the end of the class description.

entries: You can increase one ability score by 2, or you can increase two ability scores by 1. You can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You can increase one ability score by 2, or you can increase two ability scores by 1. You can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement

classFeature.name: Multitasker
entries: You can take a second {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} each round.

Additionally, when a friendly creature you can see that can hear you is forced to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to target them with your Critical Analysis feature.

classFeature.name: Calm and Collected
entries: When you make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} caused by an effect you can see, you may gain a bonus to the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} equal to your Intelligence modifier.
You can use this feature five times. You gain an additional use at 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

classFeature.name: Calm and Collected
entries: When you make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} caused by an effect you can see, you may gain a bonus to the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} equal to your Intelligence modifier.
You can use this feature five times. You gain an additional use at 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

classFeature.name: Adaptable Intellectual
entries: You are able to effectively prepare for any mission on hand. At the end of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you may choose one of the discoveries you know and replace it with another discovery that you could learn at that level.

classFeature.name: Knowledge Unbound
entries: You are the pinnacle of your pursuit. Your Intelligence score increases by 4. Your maximum for that score increases by 4. Additionally, you can use any {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} you know without expending a superiority die, rolling a {@dice d4} instead.

classFeature.name: Discoveries
entries: The discoveries are presented in alphabetical order.

entries.name: Academic Memory
entries: You can recall anything you have read in the past month that you understand. This includes but is not limited to books, maps, signs, and lists.

entries.name: Adaptive
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 15th level} When the target of your Critical Analysis feature is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to change the target of your analysis to another creature within range.

entries.name: Ambassador
entries: You learn three additional languages of your choice.
You may choose this discovery multiple times.

entries.name: Clever Applications
entries: You gain proficiency with improvised weapons, and they gain {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property} for you. Additionally, when you make an attack with an improvised weapon, it deals 1d6 damage.

You can use your Sage Advice feature to give friendly creatures improvised weapon proficiency if they don't already have it, following the same rules of that feature as if it were a skill or tool. The friendly creatures retain this proficiency for the entire duration instead.

entries.name: Expert's Advice
entries: When you use your Sage Advice feature, the first time each targeted creature makes the chosen skill check, they gain an additional bonus to the roll equal to half your Critical Analysis ability modifier.

entries.name: Hardened Mind
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level} You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against illusions and on Intelligence checks to discern them from reality.
You also gain {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to psychic damage.

entries.name: Lifelong Learning
entries: You gain proficiency in a skill and a tool, or two tools.
You can select this discovery multiple times, each time choosing a new skill and a tool, or two new tools.

entries.name: Lingering Advice
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} When you use your Sage Advice feature, the targeted creatures retain the benefit from your instruction for the full duration.

entries.name: Malleable Maneuvering
entries: You learn two additional {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers}. When you complete a {@variantrule Short Rest|sw5e-phb|short rest}, you can replace one of these {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} with another one. When you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can replace both of these {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} with other ones.

entries.name: Master's Advice
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 11th level, Expert's Advice} When you use your Sage Advice feature, the first time each targeted creature makes the chosen skill check, they gain an additional bonus to the roll equal to your Critical Analysis ability modifier.

entries.name: Mental Prowess
entries: When you make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|sw5e-phb}) check to grapple a creature or break out of a grapple, net, and other restraining equipment, you can use your Critical Analysis ability modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity.

entries.name: Moderately Armored
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You gain proficiency in {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor}.

entries.name: Perfect Maneuver
entries: Your superiority die rolls gain a minimum roll threshold, discussed in chapter 7.

entries.name: Quick Analysis
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level} When you roll {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} and aren't surprised, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to use your Critical Analysis feature.

entries.name: Rancor's Discipline
entries: You can substitute Wisdom or Charisma (chosen when you study this discipline) for Intelligence for your scholar class features, except for other discoveries and Academic Pursuit features.

entries.name: Reliable Sources
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level} Intelligence ({@skill Lore|sw5e-phb}) or Intelligence ({@skill Nature|sw5e-phb}) skill check that lets you add your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} gain a minimum roll threshold, discussed in chapter 7.

entries.name: Resolute
entries: When you make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist charm and fear effects, you may add your Intelligence modifier to the roll.

entries.name: Running on Fumes
entries: You only need 3 hours of sleep during a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} to gain its benefits, instead of 6. Additionally, if your {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} would be interrupted, you only need to complete the {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} instead of restarting it to gain its benefits. Lastly, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion}.

entries.name: Survival Expert
entries: When you make a {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} skill check, you may use your Critical Analysis ability modifier instead of your Wisdom modifier.
Additionally, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison}.

entries.name: Targeted Analysis
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} Your {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against the target of your Critical Analysis feature cannot suffer from {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

entries.name: Tech Amateur
entries: You learn and can cast one 1st-level {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. Your {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} is Intelligence. You require use of a {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} for this power.
You can select this discovery multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different power.

entries.name: Universal Language
entries: You can communicate simple ideas with any creature with an Intelligence score of 6 or higher through basic expressions and gestures.

entries.name: Versatile Maneuvers
entries: Choose two {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} you know. The chosen {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} count as {@book general maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|General} for you. You can choose another {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. Whenever you gain a level in this class, you can replace one of these {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} with another {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} you know.

classFeature.name: Academic Pursuits
entries: At 3rd level, you choose a academic pursuit that you emulate. Your choice grants features at 3rd level and again at 7th, 10th, 15th, and 18th level.

classFeature.name: Academic Pursuits feature
entries: At 6th level, you gain a feature granted by your academic pursuits.

classFeature.name: Academic Pursuits feature
entries: At 9th level, you gain a feature granted by your academic pursuits.

classFeature.name: Academic Pursuits feature
entries: At 17th level, you gain a feature granted by your academic pursuits.

classFeature.name: Ranger's Quarry
entries: You learn how to effectively read and track your prey. Once on each of your turns, you can choose a creature you can see within 120 feet and mark it as your quarry (no action required). For the next hour, you gain the following benefits:

items: Once per turn, when you hit the target with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can deal 1d4 additional damage to it of the same type as the weapon's damage. This die changes as you gain scout levels, as shown in the Ranger's Quarry column of the scout table.

You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on any Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) or Wisdom ({@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}) check you make to find it while it's on the same planet as you.

entries: You can only have one creature marked in this way at a time. Beginning at 5th level, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to mark a creature when it enters your line of sight, provided it is within range of your Ranger's Quarry.
The duration increases to 8 hours at 9th level and 24 hours at 17th level.

classFeature.name: Pathfinder
entries: You are skilled at navigating the untamed wilds. You ignore {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain}, and when traveling for an hour or more, you gain the following benefits:

items: Difficult terrain doesn't slow your group, provided they can see and hear you.
You can't become lost by unenhanced means.
Even when you are engaged in another activity while traveling (such as foraging, navigating, or tracking), you remain alert to danger.
If you are traveling alone, you can move stealthily at a normal pace.
When you forage, you find twice as much food.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} checks.

classFeature.name: Techcasting
entries: You have derived powers from schematics with the aid of your {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad}. See {@book chapter 10|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} for the general rules of {@book techcasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} and {@book chapter 12|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} for the {@book tech powers list|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

entries.name: Tech Powers Known
entries: You learn 4 {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of your choice, and you learn more at higher levels, as shown in the {@book Tech Powers Known|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} column of the scout table. You may not learn a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of a level higher than your Max Power Level.

entries.name: Tech Points
entries: You have a number of tech points equal to your scout level, as shown in the Tech Points column of the scout table, + your Intelligence modifier. You use these tech points to cast {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. You regain all expended tech points when you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Max Power Level
entries: Many {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} can be overcharged, consuming more tech points to create a greater effect. You can overcharge these powers to a maximum level, which increases at higher levels, as shown in the Max Power Level column of the scout table.
You may only cast {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} at 4th and 5th-level once. You regain the ability to do so after a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Techcasting Ability
entries: Intelligence is your {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} for your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. You use your Intelligence whenever a power refers to your {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability}. Additionally, you use your Intelligence modifier when setting the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} DC for a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you cast and when making an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} with one.
{@b Tech save DC} = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Intelligence modifier
{@b Tech attack modifier} = your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Intelligence modifier

entries.name: Techcasting Focus
entries: You use a {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} (found in {@book chapter 5|sw5e-phb|5}) as a tech focus for your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

classFeature.name: Fighting Style
entries: You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one of the {@book fighting style options, detailed in chapter 6|sw5e-phb|6|Fighting Styles}.

classFeature.name: Scout Routine
entries: You've developed one routine, as detailed at the end of the class description, and you gain more at higher levels, as shown in the Routines Known column of the scout table. Your routine has a radius of 5 feet, which increases at higher levels, as shown in the Routine Radius column of the scout table.

classFeature.name: Scout Technique
entries: You choose to focus on a specific scout technique, which is detailed at the end of the class description.

classFeature.name: Extra Attack
entries: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action on your turn.

classFeature.name: Expertise
entries: Choose two of your skill proficiencies, or one of skill proficiencies and one of your tool proficiencies, or two of your tool proficiencies. You gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in those skills or tools.
At 14th level, you can choose another two proficiencies (in skills or tools) to gain this benefit.

classFeature.name: Expertise
entries: Choose two of your skill proficiencies, or one of skill proficiencies and one of your tool proficiencies, or two of your tool proficiencies. You gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in those skills or tools.
At 14th level, you can choose another two proficiencies (in skills or tools) to gain this benefit.

classFeature.name: Commando
entries: You can take the Dash or Hide actions as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on each of your turns. Additionally, you can remain perfectly still for long periods of time to set up ambushes.

When you attempt to hide on your turn, you can opt to not move on that turn. If you avoid moving, creatures that attempt to detect you take a -10 penalty to their Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks until the start of your next turn. You lose this benefit if you move or fall prone, either voluntarily or because of some external effect. You are still automatically detected if any effect or action causes you to no longer be hidden.
If you are still hidden on your next turn, you can continue to remain motionless and gain this benefit until you are detected.
Finally, you can no longer be tracked by unenhanced means, unless you choose to leave a trail.

classFeature.name: Combat Tech
entries: When you use your action to cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, you can make one {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.

classFeature.name: Supreme Awareness
entries: You gain preternatural senses that help you fight creatures you can't see. When you attack a creature you can't see, your inability to see it doesn't impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on your {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against it.

You are also aware of the location of any {@condition Invisible|sw5e-phb|invisible} creature within 30 feet of you, provided that the creature isn't hidden from you and you aren't {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded} or {@condition Deafened|sw5e-phb|deafened}.

classFeature.name: Foe Slayer
entries: You become an unparalleled hunter. Your Strength or Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 2. Your maximum for those scores increases by 2.
Additionally, once on each of your turns, you can add your Intelligence modifier to the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} or the damage roll of an attack you make.

classFeature.name: Scout Routines
entries: The routines are presented in alphabetical order. If multiple scouts grant the same routine, affected creatures can only benefit from it once. You must be conscious to grant the benefit of your routines.

entries.name: Adaptability Routine
entries: At the start of each of your turns, you can choose an ability score with a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} in which you are not proficient. Until the start of your next turn, you add half your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} to {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} you make with the chosen ability. Alternatively, you can choose to extend this benefit to allies within 5 feet of you.

entries.name: Maven's Routine
entries: At the start of each of your turns, you can choose to gain {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to damage from {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} until the start of your next turn. Alternatively, you can choose to extend this benefit to allies within 5 feet of you.

entries.name: Mesmer's Routine
entries: At the start of each of your turns, you can choose to have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against effects that would incapacitate you or put you to sleep until the start of your next turn. Alternatively, you can choose to extend this benefit to allies within 5 feet of you.

entries.name: Nomad's Routine
entries: At the start of each of your turns, you can choose to gain {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} to avoid {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} from unenhanced sources, as well as being naturally adapted to both hot and cold climates. Alternatively, you can choose to extend this benefit to allies within 5 feet of you.

entries.name: Responder's Routine
entries: When you roll {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative}, you can choose to add your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} to the {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} check and have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against creatures that have not yet acted. Alternatively, you can choose to allow each friendly creature within 5 feet of you to add half your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} to the {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} check and have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the first {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} they make against a creature that has not yet acted.

entries.name: Sharpshooter's Routine
entries: At the start of each of your turns, you can choose to gain a bonus to the first {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} roll you make before the start of your next turn equal to your Intelligence modifier. Alternatively, you can choose to allow each friendly creature within 5 feet of you to add half your Intelligence modifier to the first {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} roll they make before the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Strider's Routine
entries: At the start of each of your turns, you can choose to have each {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} level only reduce your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} by 5 feet, unless it would reduce your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} to 0 until the start of your next turn. Alternatively, you can choose to extend this benefit to allies within 5 feet of you.

entries.name: Warden's Routine
entries: At the start of each of your turns, you can choose to gain a crawling, climbing, and swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to your walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} until the start of your next turn. Alternatively, you can choose to extend this benefit to allies within 5 feet of you.

classFeature.name: Scout Techniques
entries: At 3rd level, you choose a scout technique that you emulate. Your choice grants features at 3rd level and again at 7th, 10th, 15th, and 18th level.

classFeature.name: Scout Techniques feature
entries: At 7th level, you gain a feature granted by your scout techniques.

classFeature.name: Scout Techniques feature
entries: At 11th level, you gain a feature granted by your scout techniques.

classFeature.name: Scout Techniques feature
entries: At 15th level, you gain a feature granted by your scout techniques.

classFeature.name: Forcecasting
entries: In your meditations on the force, you have learned powers, fragments of knowledge that imbue you with an abiding force ability. See {@book chapter 10|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} for the general rules of {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} and {@book chapter 11|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} for the {@book force powers list|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

entries.name: Force Powers Known
entries: You learn 7 {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of your choice, and you learn more at higher levels, as shown in the {@book Force Powers Known|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} column of the sentinel table. You may not learn a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of a level higher than your Max Power Level, and you may learn a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} at the same time you learn its prerequisite.

entries.name: Force Points
entries: You have a number of force points equal to your sentinel level x 3, as shown in the Force Points column of the sentinel table, + your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice). You use these force points to cast {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}. You regain all expended force points when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Max Power Level
entries: Many {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} can be overpowered, consuming more force points to create a greater effect. You can overpower these abilities to a maximum level, which increases at higher levels, as shown in the Max Power Level column of the sentinel table.
You may only cast {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} at 5th, 6th, and 7th-level once. You regain the ability to do so after a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Forcecasting Ability
entries: Your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} varies based on the alignment of the powers you cast. You use Wisdom for {@book light side powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, Charisma for {@book dark side powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, and Wisdom or Charisma for {@book universal powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} (your choice). You use this ability whenever a power refers to your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability}. Additionally, you use this ability modifier when setting the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} DC for a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} you cast and when making an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} with one.
{@b Force save DC} = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} modifier
{@b Force attack modifier} = your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} modifier

classFeature.name: Led by the Force
entries: You can add half your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} to any {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} you make that doesn't already include your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}.

classFeature.name: Force-Empowered Self
entries: Your training allows you to harness the mystical energy of the Force throughout your body. You learn three effects: Deflection, Double Strike, and Slow Time. Each effect costs 1 force point and uses a {@dice d4}, which changes as you gain sentinel levels, as shown in the Kinetic Combat column of the sentinel table. You can only use each effect once per round.

entries.name: Deflection
entries: When you are the target of an attack, you can roll a Kinetic Combat die and add it to your AC (no action required). You can do so before or after the attack is made, but you must choose to do so before the GM determines if the attack hits.

entries.name: Double Strike
entries: When you hit a creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can roll a Kinetic Combat die and deal additional damage of the same type equal to the amount rolled.

entries.name: Slow Time
entries: When you move on your turn, you can roll a Kinetic Combat die to increase your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} by 5 x the amount rolled until the end of your turn.

classFeature.name: Sentinel Ideals
entries: You adopt ideals that exemplify your bond with the Force. You adopt two ideals of your choice, as detailed at the end of the class description, and you adopt more at higher levels, as shown in the Ideals Known column of the sentinel table.
You can manifest your ideals a combined total of twice, and you can manifest them more times at higher levels as shown in the Ideal Manifests column of the sentinel table.

classFeature.name: Sentinel Calling
entries: You choose a sentinel calling, which is detailed at the end of the class description.

classFeature.name: Sentinel Calling
entries: You choose a sentinel calling, which is detailed at the end of the class description.

classFeature.name: Sentinel Calling
entries: You choose a sentinel calling, which is detailed at the end of the class description.

classFeature.name: Sentinel Calling
entries: You choose a sentinel calling, which is detailed at the end of the class description.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You can increase one ability score by 2, or you can increase two ability scores by 1. You can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You can increase one ability score by 2, or you can increase two ability scores by 1. You can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You can increase one ability score by 2, or you can increase two ability scores by 1. You can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You can increase one ability score by 2, or you can increase two ability scores by 1. You can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You can increase one ability score by 2, or you can increase two ability scores by 1. You can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

classFeature.name: Extra Attack
entries: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action on your turn.

classFeature.name: Battle Readiness
entries: You have fully learned how to meld your physical self with the Force. When you take the Dodge or Disengage actions, or use your action to cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, you can make one {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.

classFeature.name: Enlightened Evasion
entries: When you are subjected to an effect that forces you to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can spend 2 force points to add your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of one) to the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. If you do so, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, and only half damage if you fail.

classFeature.name: Center of the Force
entries: You are perfectly centered with the Force. Your Dexterity and Wisdom or Charisma scores (your choice) increase by 2. Your maximum for those scores increases by 2.
Additionally, once per turn, when you would roll a Kinetic Combat die, you can instead choose the maximum.

classFeature.name: Sentinel Ideals
entries: The ideals are presented in alphabetical order.

entries.name: Ideal of the Agile
entries: You gain a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} and a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to your walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. When you make a long jump, you can {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} a number of feet up to twice your Wisdom or Charisma score (your choice). When you make a high jump, you can leap a number of feet up into the air equal to 3 + twice your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice).

Additionally, as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can manifest this ideal in a brief surge of energy. For the next minute, {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks} against you are made with {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

entries.name: Ideal of the Artisan
entries: Choose one of your skill or tool proficiencies. When you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} with the chosen skill or tool, you can add half your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of one).

Additionally, as an action, you can manifest this ideal in a brief surge of energy. For the next 10 minutes, the bonus increases to your Wisdom or Charisma modifier, and you can choose a second skill or tool to extend this feature to.

entries.name: Ideal of the Contender
entries: Your unarmed strike damage increases by one step (from 1 to {@dice d4}, {@dice d4} to {@dice d6}, or {@dice d6} to {@dice d8}), and your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} gain {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property}.

Additionally, as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can manifest this ideal in a brief surge of energy. For the next minute, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} count as enhanced for the purpose of overcoming {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} and immunity to unenhanced attacks and damage, and you can use your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice) instead of Strength for checks made to grapple a target or escape a grapple.

entries.name: Ideal of the Fighter
entries: You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one of the {@book fighting style options, detailed in chapter 6|sw5e-phb|6|Fighting Styles}.

Additionally, as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can manifest this ideal in a brief surge of energy. For the next minute, you know the fighting mastery that corresponds with the fighting style you chose with this feature. If you already know that fighting mastery, you instead learn another of your choice for the duration.

entries.name: Ideal of the Hunter
entries: You gain {@spell Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision} out to a range of 60 feet. If you already have {@spell Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision}, this ideal increases its range by 30 feet.

Additionally, as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can manifest this ideal in a brief surge of energy. For the next minute, you can see normally in enhanced {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, and you gain blindsight to 10 feet.

entries.name: Ideal of the Steadfast
entries: When you would make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} roll, you can instead force the target to make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your bonus to attacks with the weapon). If you would have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on your {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, the creature instead has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, and if you would have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on your {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, the creature instead has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, the target takes normal weapon damage and is subjected to any additional effects that would occur on a hit.

Additionally, as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can manifest this ideal in a brief surge of energy. For the next minute, when a creature succeeds on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, they take half the normal weapon damage, and when a creature rolls a 1 on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, they treat the damage as if you had rolled the maximum.

entries.name: Ideal of the Titan
entries: You gain proficiency in {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor}.

Additionally, as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can manifest this ideal in a brief surge of energy. For the next minute, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} and {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} that would forcefully move another creature, and the distance they would be moved increases by 5 feet.

entries.name: Ideal of the Tranquil
entries: When you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you gain a number of temporary force points equal to half your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of one). When you would spend a force point while you have temporary force points, the temporary force points are spent first. All temporary force points are lost at the end of your next short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
Additionally, as an action, you can manifest this ideal in a brief surge of energy. You regain a number of force points equal to half your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of one).

entries.name: Ideal of the Vigorous
entries: When you roll a Hit Die to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, you may use your Wisdom or Charisma modifier in place of your Constitution modifier when determining the number of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} you regain.

Additionally, as an action, you can manifest this ideal in a brief surge of energy. You gain a number of temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to half your sentinel level + your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of one).

classFeature.name: Sentinel Callings
entries: At 3rd level, you choose a sentinel calling that you emulate. Your choice grants features at 3rd level and again at 7th, 10th, 15th, and 18th level.

classFeature.name: Sentinel Callings feature
entries: At 7th level, you gain a feature granted by your sentinel callings.

classFeature.name: Sentinel Callings feature
entries: At 13th level, you gain a feature granted by your sentinel callings.

classFeature.name: Sentinel Callings feature
entries: At 18th level, you gain a feature granted by your sentinel callings.

subclassFeature.name: Ballistic Approach
entries: For many, rushing an opponent with guns blazing is a last resort. For Berserkers of the Ballistic Approach, this isn't a last resort; it's the primary plan. Leading with a {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} and pure, unbridled rage, the berserker never lets an empty gun diminish their fury.

subclassFeature.name: Firestorm
entries: You gain proficiency in martial {@filter blasters|items|firearm=true} with the burst or rapid property. Additionally, you've learned to use ranged weapons with untold fury. While wielding a {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} with which you are proficient, you gain the following benefits:
