items: You can use your choice of Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls of {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} weapons against targets within 30 feet of you. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.
When you use a {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} as an improvised weapon, you are considered proficient with it.

subclassFeature.name: Explosive
entries: While raging, you gain the following benefits:

items: Your {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} weapon damage rolls gain a minimum roll threshold, discussed in chapter 7.
You add your rage damage to damage rolls from ranged weapon attacks using Strength.
At 9th level, when a creature rolls a 1 on a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your burst or rapid property, you can add your Brutal Critical dice to the damage.

subclassFeature.name: Explosive
entries: While raging, you gain the following benefits:

items: Your {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} weapon damage rolls gain a minimum roll threshold, discussed in chapter 7.
You add your rage damage to damage rolls from ranged weapon attacks using Strength.
At 9th level, when a creature rolls a 1 on a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your burst or rapid property, you can add your Brutal Critical dice to the damage.

subclassFeature.name: Rampage
entries: While raging, when you deal damage with a {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} with which you are proficient, and you added your Strength modifier to the damage roll, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to move up to half your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} towards your target. You must end this movement closer to your target than you started. If you end this movement within 5 feet of your target, you can make one {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} with your {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} as a part of this {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.

subclassFeature.name: Down, Not Out
entries: When you are hit with an attack by a creature within 30 feet of you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to make a single attack against that creature with a {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} with which you are proficient.

subclassFeature.name: Brawn
entries: When you use the burst property of a {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} with which are you proficient, you can apply your rage damage bonus to every target that takes damage, instead of just one. Additionally, when a Large or smaller creature fails the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your burst or rapid property while within 30 feet of you, it is knocked prone.

subclassFeature.name: Cyclone Approach
entries: The Cyclone Approach empowers the berserker's ability to fight with weapons in each hand. Followers of this approach learn to move quickly to avoid attacks and can become a {@spell Whirlwind|sw5e-phb|whirlwind} of fury and steel, cleaving through hordes of enemies.

subclassFeature.name: Dual Wielder
entries: When you engage in Two-Weapon Fighting, you can add your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice) to the damage of your Two-Weapon Fighting attack as long as it doesn't already include that modifier.

subclassFeature.name: Double Swing
entries: Once on each of your turns when you miss with an attack while raging, you can immediately make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} with a weapon wielded in a different hand.

subclassFeature.name: Twisting Winds
entries: Your unpredictable movement makes you harder to hit and pin down. When you make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} to avoid being knocked prone, pushed, {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled}, or {@condition Restrained|sw5e-phb}, you can add your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice).

subclassFeature.name: Mighty Leap
entries: The distance you can jump is doubled, and you do not provoke attacks of opportunity if you leave a hostile creature's reach while jumping.

subclassFeature.name: Tornado
entries: Once on each of your turns, you can become a tornado of attacks. When you take the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action on your turn, you can forgo one of your regular attacks to make a melee attack against any number of creatures within 5 feet of you, with a separate {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} for each target. If you are wielding a separate melee weapon in each hand, each successful hit against a target deals damage equal to the damage dice of both weapons + your ability modifier + any other modifiers.
You can use this feature five times. You gain an additional use at 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Tornado
entries: Once on each of your turns, you can become a tornado of attacks. When you take the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action on your turn, you can forgo one of your regular attacks to make a melee attack against any number of creatures within 5 feet of you, with a separate {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} for each target. If you are wielding a separate melee weapon in each hand, each successful hit against a target deals damage equal to the damage dice of both weapons + your ability modifier + any other modifiers.
You can use this feature five times. You gain an additional use at 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Juggernaut Approach
entries: Certain berserkers find that the strongest offense is a good defense. Berserkers of the Juggernaut Approach wear the heaviest of armor not because they fear injury, but to strike fear in their hapless attackers.

subclassFeature.name: Armored Brute
entries: You've learned to fight in the heaviest of armors, using your weight to your {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}. You gain proficiency in {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}, you can enter a rage while wearing {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}, and you can gain the benefits of your Rage feature while wearing {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}.

subclassFeature.name: Unstoppable Force
entries: Your momentum makes you nigh unstoppable. While raging, you can move through a hostile creature's space regardless of that creature's size. When you do so, you must make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) check contested by the target's Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) check. If you move at least 10 feet before moving through a hostile creature's space, and that creature is your size or smaller, they have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the check. If you succeed, you don't treat the movement as {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain}, the creature is pushed 5 feet in a direction of your choice, and you don't provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks} from that creature until the end of your turn.

subclassFeature.name: Raging Bulwark
entries: Your imposing form acts as a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} for your allies. When a friendly creature you can see is the target of a ranged attack, or forced to make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, and you can see the source of the effect, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to move up to half your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} towards the friendly creature. You must end this move closer to the ally than you started. If you end this movement between your ally and the source of the effect, you {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|provide cover} for the attack.

Additionally, you provide three-quarters {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover}, instead of half-{@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover}, to creatures of the same size category, and you provide full {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover}, instead of three-quarters {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover}, to creatures one size smaller than you.

subclassFeature.name: Overwhelming Cleave
entries: When you successfully push a creature into a surface or another creature while raging, the pushed creature takes kinetic damage equal to your Rage Damage. Additionally, the first time you hit with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} using Strength each turn, you can attempt to damage another creature with the same attack. Choose another creature within 5 feet of the original target and within your reach. If the original {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} would hit the second creature, it takes damage equal to your Strength modifier. The damage is of the same type dealt by the original attack.

subclassFeature.name: Relentless Assault
entries: You're able to {@optfeature Charge|sw5e-phb|charge} in unerring bursts. As an action, you can {@optfeature Charge|sw5e-phb|charge} up to twice your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} in a straight line without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks}. Each creature within 5 feet of your path must make a Strength or Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Strength modifier, the target chooses the ability they use use). On a failed save, a creature takes damage equal to your Strength modifier + your Rage damage and, if it is no more than one size category larger than you, is pushed back 5 feet in a direction of your choice. Creatures smaller than you make this save with {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}. When you end this movement, if a creature is within 5 feet of you, you can make one {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} (no action required). On a hit, the creature takes additional damage equal to your berserker level.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

subclassFeature.name: Marauder Approach
entries: Few things are more terrifying than being in the path of a Berserker who has learned the ways of the Force. Those who follow this path unlock something deep within them, a well of untamed power from the depths of their fury. When a marauder unleashes their rage, they channel their brute strength into primal might, and uses it to devastate his foes in a hail of fire, blades, and blood. Due to the uncontrolled nature of their powers, marauders have a dangerous predilection for the strength and raw power offered by the dark side, and many fall into it's clutches. Even those who do not are always temped by the voices of fury barely contained within.

subclassFeature.name: Forcecasting
entries: You have derived powers from your primal connection to the Force. See {@book chapter 10|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} for the general rules of {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} and {@book chapter 11|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} for the {@book force powers list|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

entries.name: Force Powers Known
entries: You learn 4 {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of your choice, and you learn more at higher levels, as shown in the {@book Force Powers Known|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} column of the Marauder Approach {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} table. You may not learn a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of a level higher than your Max Power Level, and you may learn a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} at the same time you learn its prerequisite.

entries.name: Force Points
entries: You have a number of force points equal to your berserker level, as shown in the Force Points column of the Marauder Approach {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} table, + your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice). You use these force points to cast {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}. You regain all expended force points when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Max Power Level
entries: Many {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} can be overpowered, consuming more force points to create a greater effect. You can overpower these abilities to a maximum level, which increases at higher levels, as shown in the Max Power Level column of the Marauder Approach {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} table.
You may only cast {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} at 4th-level once. You regain the ability to do so after a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Forcecasting Ability
entries: Your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} varies based on the alignment of the powers you cast. You use Wisdom for {@book light side powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, Charisma for {@book dark side powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, and Wisdom or Charisma for {@book universal powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} (your choice). You use this ability whenever a power refers to your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability}. Additionally, you use this ability modifier when setting the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} DC for a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} you cast and when making an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} with one.
{@b Force save DC} = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} modifier
{@b Force attack modifier} = your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} modifier

subclassFeature.name: Furious Force
entries: You can cast {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} while raging as long as the power's casting time is no more than 1 action, the power does not require {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration}, and you are not wearing {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}. While raging, you add your rage damage to damage rolls from {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} you cast that require a force attack or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. If a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} damages more than one target, you may only apply your rage damage to one of them.

Casting {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} during rage counts as attacking for the purposes of maintaining rage, and you can use your Reckless Attack feature to gain {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} when casting a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} that requires a force attack.

subclassFeature.name: Reckless Power
entries: Weapons and the force are equally an extension of your rage. While you are raging and you use your action to cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, you can make a single {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.

subclassFeature.name: Powerful Presence
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you unleash a battle cry infused with force energy. Choose up to ten other creatures of within 60 feet of you that can hear you. Friendly creatures have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} and {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} until the start of your next turn, and hostile creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} and {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} until the end of your next turn.
Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Force Storm
entries: You can expel the might of your rage all at once to unleash a devastating storm of force energy. As an action, you can end your rage early, forcing each creature within 15 feet of you to make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your universal force save DC. On a failed save, a creature takes 1d12 force damage for each round you've spent in rage, or half as much on a successful one.

subclassFeature.name: Way of Balance
entries: There is serenity in balance, and no one knows this better than the consular. Those consulars who follow the Way of Balance focus on utilizing the Force to equalize the battlefield. They bend the Force to {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} their allies and expose their foes.

subclassFeature.name: Force Barrier
entries: You can weave the Force around yourself for protection. When you cast a universal power of 1st level or higher, you can simultaneously manipulate the Force to create a barrier on yourself that lasts until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. The barrier has {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to twice your consular level + your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice). Your barrier can never have {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} greater than twice your consular level + your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice).
Whenever you take damage, the barrier takes the damage instead. If this damage reduces the barrier to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, you take any remaining damage.

While the barrier has 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, it can't absorb damage, but its power remains. Whenever you cast a universal power of 1st level or higher, the barrier regains a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to twice the level of the power.
Once you create the barrier, you can't create it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Projected Barrier
entries: When a creature that you can see within 30 feet of you takes damage, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to cause your {@spell Force Barrier|sw5e-phb} to absorb that damage. If this damage reduces the barrier to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, the warded creature takes any remaining damage.

subclassFeature.name: At-Will Barrier
entries: Your at-will {@book universal powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} grant a small boost to your {@spell Force Barrier|sw5e-phb}. When you cast an at-will universal power, the barrier regains 1 hit point. You can't restore your barrier above half its maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} in this way.

subclassFeature.name: Improved Suppression
entries: When you cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} that requires you to make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} as a part of casting that power, such as {@i sever force} or {@i force suppression}, you add your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} to that {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}.

subclassFeature.name: Force Resistance
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}. Additionally, you have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} against the damage of {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

subclassFeature.name: Way of Lightning
entries: Of all of the dark arts of the Force, little can match the spectacle and devastation of {@spell Force Lightning|sw5e-phb|Force lightning}. Those consulars who follow the Way of Lightning summon intense discharges of pure Force energy, overwhelming enemies with punishing damage from a distance, leaving them shaken and vulnerable -- if not dead.

subclassFeature.name: Shocking Affinity
entries: When you cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} that deals lightning damage, you can use Wisdom or Charisma as your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} for it.

Additionally, when you cast a damage-dealing {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} that requires a force attack or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can cause that power to instead deal lightning damage. If the power would call for a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} other than Dexterity, it instead calls for a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. If you hit with the power, or the target fails the power's {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, affected creatures become {@i shocked} until the start of your next turn. You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Potent Lightning
entries: You add your governing ability modifier (minimum of +1) to any damage you deal with {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} that deal lightning damage that don't already include that modifier.

subclassFeature.name: Blistering Rebuke
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of you that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to cause the creature to make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your universal force save DC. On a failed save, the creature takes 1d10 plus your consular level lightning damage, is pushed back 10 feet, and becomes {@i shocked} until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't moved or {@i shocked}.
You can use this feature four times. You gain an additional use at 13th and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Blistering Rebuke
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of you that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to cause the creature to make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your universal force save DC. On a failed save, the creature takes 1d10 plus your consular level lightning damage, is pushed back 10 feet, and becomes {@i shocked} until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't moved or {@i shocked}.
You can use this feature four times. You gain an additional use at 13th and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Blistering Rebuke
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of you that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to cause the creature to make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your universal force save DC. On a failed save, the creature takes 1d10 plus your consular level lightning damage, is pushed back 10 feet, and becomes {@i shocked} until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't moved or {@i shocked}.
You can use this feature four times. You gain an additional use at 13th and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Electric Attunement
entries: You gain {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to lightning damage, and {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} you cast ignore {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to lightning damage.

subclassFeature.name: Unlimited Power
entries: You can increase the power of your simpler lightning {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}. When you cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of 1st through 6th level that deals lightning damage, you can deal maximum damage with that power.

You can use this feature with no adverse effects a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, as shown in the consular table. If you use this feature beyond this before you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you take 2d12 true damage for each level of the power, immediately after you cast it. Each time you use this feature again before finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, the damage increases by 1d12.

subclassFeature.name: Way of Suggestion
entries: There is power in a light touch, and no one knows this better than the consular. Those consulars who follow the Way of Suggestion have honed their attunement to the Force, allowing them to disappear, despite being in plain sight.

subclassFeature.name: Subtle Control
entries: You can befuddle a creature's mind with nothing but a gesture. As an action, you can cause a creature you can see within 30 feet to make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your universal force save DC. On a failed save, you can force the creature to believe or forget a single aspect of a conversation, observation or encounter it had that you were present for in the past 10 minutes. Whether the creature succeeds or fails their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can't use this feature on them again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

Additionally, creatures who attempt to detect your use of the Force have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} to do so, and if a creature has the {@i sense force} or {@i force sight} power active, they must succeed on a universal {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} check against your universal force save DC in order to notice your usage of the Force, your alignment within the Force, or how strong your connection to the Force is.

subclassFeature.name: Out of Mind
entries: You can erase yourself from a single creature's sight momentarily. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, choose a creature within 60 feet of you that you are aware of. That creature must make a  Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your universal force save DC. On a failed save, you become {@condition Invisible|sw5e-phb|invisible} to that creature for 1 minute, or until you deal damage to it.
Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Delicate Potency
entries: Your mind-affecting powers are particularly potent. When you cast one of {@i cloud mind}, {@i dominate mind}, {@i mass coerce mind}, and {@i dominate monster}, you can choose to treat the power as if cast at your Max Power Level.
You can use this feature four times. You gain an additional use at 13th and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Delicate Potency
entries: Your mind-affecting powers are particularly potent. When you cast one of {@i cloud mind}, {@i dominate mind}, {@i mass coerce mind}, and {@i dominate monster}, you can choose to treat the power as if cast at your Max Power Level.
You can use this feature four times. You gain an additional use at 13th and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Delicate Potency
entries: Your mind-affecting powers are particularly potent. When you cast one of {@i cloud mind}, {@i dominate mind}, {@i mass coerce mind}, and {@i dominate monster}, you can choose to treat the power as if cast at your Max Power Level.
You can use this feature four times. You gain an additional use at 13th and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Delayed Effect
entries: When you cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, you can delay the effects of the {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} for up to a number of rounds equal to half your consular level. If you do so, the power immediately takes effect at the start of your turn, after the specified number of rounds have passed.
Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Subtle Presence
entries: You've learned how to weave the Force around you in a cloak of your choice. As an action, you can focus the Force for 10 minutes. For the duration, you gain your choice of one of the following effects.
You can use each feature once. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Cloak of Fright
entries: Each creature of your choice that is within 60 feet must succeed on a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your universal force save DC or become {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: Cloak of Invisibility
entries: You and everything you are wearing or carrying become {@condition Invisible|sw5e-phb|invisible} to creatures of your choice. If you damage a creature or affect it with a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, it can make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your universal force save DC. On a success, you are no longer {@condition Invisible|sw5e-phb|invisible} to that creature.

entries.name: Cloak of Memory
entries: Creatures that see you or any allies within 30 feet of you during this time cannot recall your physical appearances, your mannerisms, or any other identifying features.

Creatures that interact with you must make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your universal force save DC once the interaction ends. You can choose to exclude a creature from this effect. On a failed save, the creature forgets all details of the interaction, rationalizing any of its outcomes.

subclassFeature.name: Way of the Sage
entries: The rejuvenating power of the Force is incredible, and the consular is the master of this usage. Those consulars who follow the Way of the Sage {@optfeature Assist|sw5e-phb|assist} with an array of healing powers that grant allies the strength to continue through even the harshest of encounters. Separated from the heart of the fray, the sage can be an unfailing warden to those in need.

subclassFeature.name: Disciple of Life
entries: When you cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} that restores {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, you can use Wisdom or Charisma as your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} for it.

Additionally, whenever you use a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of 1st level or higher to restore {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to a creature, the creature regains extra {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to 2 + the power's level.

subclassFeature.name: Preserve Life
entries: As an action, you can channel the Force and evoke healing energy that restores a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to five times your consular level. Choose any creatures within 30 feet of you, and divide those {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} among them. This feature can restore a creature to no more than half its hit point maximum. This feature has no effect on droids or constructs.
You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Preserve Life
entries: As an action, you can channel the Force and evoke healing energy that restores a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to five times your consular level. Choose any creatures within 30 feet of you, and divide those {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} among them. This feature can restore a creature to no more than half its hit point maximum. This feature has no effect on droids or constructs.
You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Preserve Life
entries: As an action, you can channel the Force and evoke healing energy that restores a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to five times your consular level. Choose any creatures within 30 feet of you, and divide those {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} among them. This feature can restore a creature to no more than half its hit point maximum. This feature has no effect on droids or constructs.
You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Preserve Life
entries: As an action, you can channel the Force and evoke healing energy that restores a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to five times your consular level. Choose any creatures within 30 feet of you, and divide those {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} among them. This feature can restore a creature to no more than half its hit point maximum. This feature has no effect on droids or constructs.
You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Blessed Healer
entries: The healing powers you cast on others heal you as well. When you cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} that restores {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to a creature other than you, you regain {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to 2 + the power's level.

subclassFeature.name: Blessed by the Force
entries: You gain the ability to overcome grievous injuries. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} when you have fewer than half your {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} remaining, you can regain a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to half your hit point maximum.
Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Supreme Healing
entries: When you would normally roll one or more dice to restore {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} with a power, you instead use the highest number possible for each die. For instance, instead of restoring 2d6 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to a creature, you restore 12.

subclassFeature.name: Armormech Engineering
entries: Those engineers who choose the Armormech Engineering discipline focus on the ability to work with hard metals and electronic shielding to construct and enhance all types of personal armor.

subclassFeature.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: You gain proficiency in {@item Armormech's implements|sw5e-phb|armormech's implements}, {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor}, and {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}. Additionally, when you engage in crafting with {@item Armormech's implements|sw5e-phb|armormech's implements}, the rate at which you craft doubles.

subclassFeature.name: Modified Armor
entries: You learn to modify one unenhanced suit of armor or {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} utilizing your armormech knowledge. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can modify one suit of armor or a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}. You must have the armor or {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} and {@item Armormech's implements|sw5e-phb|armormech's implements} in order to {@optfeature Perform|sw5e-phb|perform} this modification.

Your modified armor or {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} is enhanced, requires attunement, can only be used by you, and counts as a tech focus for your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} while you are attuned to it. Your modified armor has 4 modification slots, and it gains more at higher levels, as shown in the Modification Slots column of the engineer table. For each modification installed in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your tech point maximum is reduced by 1. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can install, replace, or remove a number of modifications up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one).
Some modification effects require {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}. When you use such an effect from this class, the DC equals your tech save DC.

At 9th level, you can maintain both a modified suit of armor and {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}. Each modified item has modification slots as shown in the Modification Slots column of the engineer table.

subclassFeature.name: Damage Absorption
entries: When you take damage, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend one use of your Potent Aptitude to absorb some of that damage. When you do so, the damage you take from the attack is reduced by the amount rolled on the die + your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1). You must be wearing your modified armor or wielding your modified {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} to gain this benefit.

subclassFeature.name: Extra Attack
entries: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action on your turn. You must be wearing your modified armor or wielding your modified {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} to gain this benefit.

subclassFeature.name: Armormech's Celerity
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action or use your action to a cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of 1st-level or higher, you can make one {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.
You can use this feature five times. You gain an additional use at 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Armormech's Celerity
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action or use your action to a cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of 1st-level or higher, you can make one {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.
You can use this feature five times. You gain an additional use at 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Suit Reliability
entries: Your suit is like a second skin. Ability checks and {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} you make that use Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution gain a minimum roll threshold, discussed in chapter 7. You must be wearing your modified armor or wielding your modified {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} to gain this benefit.

subclassFeature.name: Armormech Modifications
entries: The modifications are presented in alphabetical order.

entries.name: Absorption Shield
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Physical Shield} You modify your physical {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} to block incoming damage. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} you can activate this ability and gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to 1d4 + Intelligence modifier, which last for one hour.
You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain any expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Accelerated Movement
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Armor} You reduce the weight of your modified armor's bulk and increase the power to joints. If the armor has a Strength requirement, you ignore it. The modified armor's weight is reduced by 15 lbs. While wearing your modified armor your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases by 10 feet. This applies to all movement speeds you have while wearing your armor.

entries.name: Adaptable Armor
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Armor} You integrate deployable hooks and fins into your armor, augmenting its mobility. While wearing your modified armor, you gain a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to your walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}, and you can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving your hands free. Additionally, you gain a swim {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to your walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}.

entries.name: Advanced Power Fist
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 11th level, Prototype Power Fist} You further modify your modified armor's gauntlet with increased reinforcement and weight. Your modified armor's unarmed strike deals 1d8 kinetic damage. Additionally, your {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} range with your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} increases by 1.

entries.name: Artificially Intelligent
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level, Armor} You install an artificial intelligence into your modified armor. While wearing your modified armor, when you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, your armor's artificial intelligence can take the {@action Help|sw5e-phb} action.
You can use this feature four times. You gain an additional use at 13th and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Bonded Plates
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You gain a +1 bonus to AC against melee attacks. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Collapsible Suit
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level, Armor} Your modified armor can collapse into a case for easy storage. When transformed this way the armor is indistinguishable from a normal case and weighs one- third its normal weight. As an action you can don or doff the armor, allowing it to transform as needed.

entries.name: Darkvision Visor
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Armor} While wearing your modified armor, you have {@spell Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision} to a range of 60 feet. If you already have {@spell Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision}, this modification increases its range by 30 feet.

entries.name: Enhanced Endurance
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Armor} When you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} while wearing your modified armor but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You can't use this feature again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Electroshock Shield
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Shield Generator} You install electroshockers in your {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} generator. Whenever an enemy misses you with a melee attack, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to do 1d4 + your Intelligence modifier lightning damage to the attacker.

entries.name: Flight
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level, Armor} You integrate a propulsion system into your modified armor. While wearing your modified armor you have an enhanced flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.

entries.name: Grappling Harpoon
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Armor} Your modified armor gains an integrated grappling harpoon set into your gauntlet. With this harpoon, you can make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} with a range of 30/60. On a hit, it deals 1d6 kinetic damage. This attack can target a surface, object, or creature.

A creature struck by this attack is impaled by the harpoon. As an action, a creature can attempt to remove the harpoon. Removing the harpoon requires a Strength check. While the harpoon is stuck in the target, you are connected to the target by a 60 foot cable.

While the harpoon is deployed, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to activate the reel, pulling yourself to the location if the target is larger than you. A creature or object your size or smaller is pulled to you. Alternatively, you can opt to {@spell Release|sw5e-phb|release} the cable (no action required).
Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you recover and reinsert the harpoon as an action.

entries.name: Heavy Suit
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level, Armor} You enhance your suit, making it difficult to move. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can anchor or deanchor your feet to the ground. While anchored, your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 0, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength checks and Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}, and your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples.

entries.name: Infiltration Suit
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Armor} You install a cloaking device in your modified armor. This device has 2 charges. As an action you can use 1 {@optfeature Charge|sw5e-phb|charge} to cast {@i infiltrate} targeting yourself.
The cloaking device regains all expended charges after a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Magnetized Shield
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Physical Shield} You modify your physical {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} such that when a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} misses you by an amount less than or equal to your bonus to AC from your {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}, the attacking creature must make a Strength check against your tech save DC. On a failed save, the creature's weapon adheres to the {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}. As an action, a creature can repeat this check. On a success, the weapon is freed.

entries.name: Overload Shield
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Shield Generator} You modify your {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} generator to {@spell Overload|sw5e-phb|overload}. As an action you can {@spell Overload|sw5e-phb|overload} your {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}. Each Large or smaller creature within 5 feet of you must make a Dexterity or Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (their choice). On a failed save, they are pushed back 5 feet and knocked prone.
You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain any expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Power Fist
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Armor} You modify your modified armor gauntlet with increased reinforcement and weight. Your modified armor's unarmed strike deals 1d4 kinetic damage.
Additionally, when you take the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action and make an unarmed strike, you can make an additional unarmed strike as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Prototype Power Fist
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level, Power Fist} You further modify your modified armor gauntlet with increased reinforcement and weight. Your modified armor's unarmed strike deals 1d6 kinetic damage and has the following property.

If you or your target move at least 10 feet in a straight line immediately before making an unarmed strike, the first unarmed strike you make deals additional damage equal to your Intelligence modifier.

entries.name: Reinforced Underlay
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You gain a +1 bonus to AC against ranged attacks. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Resistance
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Armor} You tune your modified armor against certain forms of damage. Choose acid, cold, fire, ion, lightning, or sonic damage. While wearing your modified armor you have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to that type of damage.
You can select this modification multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different damage type.

entries.name: Sealed Suit
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level, Armor} As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} you can hermetically seal your modified armor, giving you an air supply for up to 1 hour and making you immune to {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} (but not curing you of existing {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb} conditions). Your armor regains 1 minute of air for every minute that you are not submerged and the armor is not sealed.

Additionally, while you are wearing your modified armor you are considered adapted to cold and hot climates as well as high altitude, as described in {@book chapter 5|sw5e-phb|5} of the Dungeon Master's Guide.

entries.name: Sentient Armor
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 13th level, Artificially Intelligent} Your artificial intelligence has learned to control the suit without you being in it. It is now a valid target of the {@i tracker droid interface} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

While your armor is acting independently, it uses your ability scores, {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}, and skills, and it has {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your engineer level. If reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, it falls directly to the ground, and it can not be equipped again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Shield Amplifier
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Shield Generator} You modify your {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} generator to {@spell Project|sw5e-phb|project} outward. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} you can amplify your {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} until the start of your next turn. Each creature within 5 feet of you gains a bonus to AC equal to your {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}'s bonus.
You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain any expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Shield Anchor
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Physical Shield} You modify your {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} to be used as a portable source of {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover}. As an action, you can anchor or deanchor the {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}. While anchored, you gain no benefit from a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}, and it does not require the use of a hand. Instead, while anchored, a light {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} provides one-quarter {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover}, a medium {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} provides {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|half cover}, and a heavy {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} provides three-quarters {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover}.

entries.name: Tech Blast
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Armor} You modify your modified armor gauntlet with a {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} weapon with which you are proficient. The weapon uses your Intelligence modifier for its attack and damage rolls, and deals 1d8 energy damage on a hit. It has a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 120 feet.

entries.name: Weapon Integration Armoring
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Armor} You can integrate a single weapon that weighs no more than 8 lb. into your armor. While integrated, that weapon gains the hidden property. Additionally, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} to avoid being disarmed.

subclassFeature.name: Armstech Engineering
entries: Those engineers who choose the Armstech Engineeering discipline focus on the skill of constructing and modifying {@filter blasters|items|firearm=true} and {@filter vibroweapons|items|type=martial weapon}.

subclassFeature.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: You gain proficiency in {@item Armstech's implements|sw5e-phb|armstech's implements}, {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor}, martial {@filter blasters|items|firearm=true}, and martial {@filter vibroweapons|items|type=martial weapon}. Additionally, when you engage in crafting with {@item Armstech's implements|sw5e-phb|armstech's implements}, the rate at which you craft doubles.

subclassFeature.name: Modified Weaponry
entries: You learn to modify one unenhanced weapon with which you are proficient utilizing your armstech experience. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can modify the weapon. You must have the weapon and {@item Armstech's implements|sw5e-phb|armstech's implements} in order to {@optfeature Perform|sw5e-phb|perform} this modification.

Your modified weapon is enhanced, requires attunement, can only be used by you, and counts as a tech focus for your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} while you are attuned to it. Your modified weapon has 4 modification slots, and it gains more at higher levels, as shown in the Modification Slots column of the engineer table. For each modification installed in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your tech point maximum is reduced by 1. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can install, replace, or remove a number of modifications up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one).
Some modification effects require {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}. When you use such an effect from this class, the DC equals your tech save DC.
At 9th level, you can maintain two modified weapons. Each modified weapon has modification slots as shown in the Modification Slots column of the engineer table.

subclassFeature.name: Close Call
entries: When you make an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} with your modified weapon and miss, you can expend one use of your Potent Aptitude to attempt to turn that miss into a hit. Roll the die and add it to the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}.

subclassFeature.name: Armstech's Strike
entries: Once per round, when you deal damage to a creature with your modified weapon, you can increase the damage by 1d6. The damage is of the same type as the weapon's damage.
The damage increases to 2d6 at 11th level and 3d6 at 17th level.

subclassFeature.name: Targeting Matrix
entries: When you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} that allows you to force creatures in an area to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can instead make an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} with your modified weapon against a single target that would be in the range of the power. On a hit, the target suffers the effects as though they failed their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. If the power would affect more than one creature, it instead affects only one.
You can use this feature five times. You gain an additional use at 17th level. You regain any expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Targeting Matrix
entries: When you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} that allows you to force creatures in an area to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can instead make an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} with your modified weapon against a single target that would be in the range of the power. On a hit, the target suffers the effects as though they failed their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. If the power would affect more than one creature, it instead affects only one.
You can use this feature five times. You gain an additional use at 17th level. You regain any expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Armstech's Salvo
entries: When you use your Targeting Matrix feature, and the {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} would affect more than one creature, you can instead attack each affected creature that would be in the range of the power. Make a separate {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} for each target. On a hit, each target suffers the effects as though they failed their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.

subclassFeature.name: Armstech Modifications
entries: The modifications are presented in alphabetical order.

entries.name: Accuracy Focus
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level, {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true}} You gain a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} made with this weapon. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Amplifying Barrel
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level, {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true}} You gain a +1 bonus to damage rolls made with this weapon. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Bayonet
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true}} You affix a short blade to the barrel of your modified {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} weapon, allowing you to make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} with it. The blade is a {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon} weapon with {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property} that you are proficient with, and deals 1d6 kinetic damage.

entries.name: Burst Core
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true}} Your weapon gains the burst property, with a burst number equal to its reload number.

entries.name: Booming Strikes
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You pack extra power into your modified weapon. Once per turn, when you hit with the weapon, you can deal an additional 1d6 damage. If you do so, the weapon makes a loud boom which can be heard 100 feet away. If you are hidden, Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}) and Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks made to locate you that rely on sound have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}.

entries.name: Celerity Oscillator
entries: Once per turn, when you deal damage with your modified weapon, your walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases by 10 feet until the start of your next turn, and the damaged creature can't make {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks} against you for the rest of your turn.

entries.name: Collapsible Frame
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon}} You install an expandable hilt on your modified weapon. Your modified weapon gains the reach property.

entries.name: Compensation Oscillator
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon} with the dexterity property} You install a compensation oscillator in your modified {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon}, removing the dexterity property from it.

entries.name: Contoured Grip
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level, {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon}} You gain a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} made with this weapon. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Expanded Magazine
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true}} Your modified weapon can be more efficiently reloaded. You can reload your modified weapon once without using an action. You can't use this feature again until you reload the weapon with an action.

entries.name: Flashlight
entries: You affix a targeted light to your weapon. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can toggle the light on or off. While on, your weapon sheds bright light in a 60-foot cone.

entries.name: Harpoon Reel
entries: You install a secondary firemode that launches a harpoon attached to a tightly coiled cord. With this harpoon, you can make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} with a range of 30/60. On a hit, it deals 1d6 kinetic damage. This attack can target a surface, object, or creature.

A creature struck by this attack is impaled by the harpoon. As an action, a creature can attempt to remove the harpoon. Removing the harpoon requires a Strength check. While the harpoon is stuck in the target, you are connected to the target by a 60 foot cable.

While connected in this manner, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to activate the reel, pulling yourself to the location if the target is your size or larger. A creature or object smaller than you is pulled to you. Alternatively, you can opt to {@spell Release|sw5e-phb|release} the cable (no action required).
Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you recover and reinsert the harpoon as an action.

entries.name: Imbue Weapon
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level} You modify your weapon to carry a {@optfeature Charge|sw5e-phb|charge}. Over the course of a {@variantrule Short Rest|sw5e-phb|short rest}, you can cast an at-will {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, channeling it into your weapon. The next time you hit with your weapon, the stored power is released. If the power would require an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, make a tech {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}. If the power would require a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, the target must make the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} as normal. On a hit, or a failure, the target suffers the power's normal effects.

entries.name: Improved Burst Core
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level, Burst Core} Your weapon's burst number is reduced to half its reload number.

entries.name: Integrated Magazine
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Expanded Magazine} Your modified weapon can be more efficiently reloaded. You can reload your modified weapon twice without using an action. You can't use this feature again until you reload the weapon with an action.

entries.name: Jagged Oscillator
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon}} When you critically hit with the weapon, you deal an additional 1d8 kinetic damage.

entries.name: Keen Oscillator
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level, Jagged Oscillator} Your weapon's {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} range increases by 1.

entries.name: Neutronium Edge
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level, {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon}} You gain a +1 bonus to damage rolls made with this weapon. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Overcharge Weapon
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 11th level, Booming Strikes} You gain the ability to channel your {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} to enhance your weapon's damage. You can expend one tech slot to deal additional damage to the target. The extra damage is 1d6 for a 1st-level tech slot, plus 1d6 for each slot level higher than 1st, to a maximum of 5d6. The damage is the same type as the weapon damage. If you also use your Booming Strikes with an attack, you add this damage to the extra damage of your Booming Strikes.

entries.name: Power Loop
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level} When you hit with the weapon, you can choose to channel the energy generated, gaining temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to half the damage dealt.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Recoil Dampener
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} with the strength property} You install a recoil dampener in your modified {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true}, removing the strength property from it.

entries.name: Returning Weapon Guard
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon}} You install a retractible chain in your modified {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon}. If the weapon does not already have the thrown property, it gains it with a range of 20/60. Additionally, it gains the returning property.

entries.name: Screening Weapon
entries: You modify your modified weapon with a sound dampening module. When you make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} with your weapon while hidden, {@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb} and {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} checks made to locate you that rely on sound have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

entries.name: Shock Absorber
entries: You add a reclamation device to your modified weapon to gather energy from the surroundings when it is present. While wielding your modified weapon, you can cast the {@i absorb energy} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} and the power's extra damage applies to both melee and ranged weapon attacks.

entries.name: Siege Weapon
entries: You modify your weapon to be more effective against barriers. Your weapon deals double damage against structures.

entries.name: Shocking Harpoon
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level, Harpoon Reel} After hitting a creature with the harpoon fire mode, you can use the connection to deliver an at-will {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can cast an at-will {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} at the target with a range of touch. If the power requires an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}. If the target requires a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.
Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you recover the harpoon.

entries.name: Shocking Oscillator
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level, {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon}} When you hit with the weapon, you can create an electronic burst. Each creature in a 15-foot cone centered on the creature you hit must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, taking 1d8 lightning damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Snap Fire
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level, {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true}} You modify your modified {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} weapon for quick shots. You can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to take a {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attack} with your modified weapon if an enemy comes within 10 feet of you. You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on this attack.

entries.name: Staggering Oscillator
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon}} When you hit with the weapon, you can force the target to make a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, the creature is pushed back 10 feet and knocked prone.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Tracker
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You add a tracking mechanism to your modified weapon. The tracker has 3 charges. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} you can use 1 {@optfeature Charge|sw5e-phb|charge} to cast {@i target lock}. As an action you can use 2 charges to cast {@i detect invisibility}.
The tracker regains all expended charges after a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Truelight
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 11th level, Flashlight} You modify your flashlight with a toggle allowing you to briefly gain enhanced sight. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can activate the truesight feature of your flashlight. When toggled on, for the next minute your flashlight now automatically dispel illusions and can {@spell Detect Invisibility|sw5e-phb|detect invisibility}, as with truesight.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Venomous Oscillator
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level, {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon}} As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can coat your weapon in a thin layer of {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} for 1 minute. The next time you hit with the weapon, the creature must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your tech save DC. On a failed save, a creature takes 1d10 {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} damage and becomes {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb} for 1 minute.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

subclassFeature.name: Gadgeteer Engineering
entries: Those engineers who choose the Gadgeteer discipline focus on the ability to craft reusable consumables and items that augment and complement their {@book techcasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} abilities.

subclassFeature.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: You gain proficiency in {@item Gadgeteer's implements|sw5e-phb|gadgeteer's implements}. Additionally, when you engage in crafting with {@item Gadgeteer's implements|sw5e-phb|gadgeteer's implements}, the rate at which you craft doubles.

subclassFeature.name: Gadgeteer Harness
entries: You learn to create and modify adventuring gear utilizing your gadgeteer experience. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can create your modified gadgeteer harness. You must have {@item Gadgeteer's implements|sw5e-phb|gadgeteer's implements} in order to {@optfeature Perform|sw5e-phb|perform} this modification.

Your gadgeteer harness is enhanced, requires attunement, can only be used by you, and counts as a tech focus for your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} while you are attuned to it. Your gadgeteer harness has 4 modification slots to which you can affix gadgets, and it gains more at higher levels, as shown in the Modification Slots column of the engineer table. For each modification installed in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your tech point maximum is reduced by 1. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can install, replace, or remove a number of modifications up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one).
Some modification effects require {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}. When you use such an effect from this class, the DC equals your tech save DC.

subclassFeature.name: Projected Barrier
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} while wearing your gadgeteer harness, you can expend a use of your Potent Aptitude to {@spell Project|sw5e-phb|project} a barrier on a friendly creature you can see within 30 feet. A creature can only have one barrier active at a time.

entries.name: Environmental Barrier
entries: You {@spell Project|sw5e-phb|project} an environmental barrier that lasts until the end of your next short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. The barrier has a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the amount rolled on your Potent Aptitude die + your engineer level. Whenever a creature with this barrier takes damage (one of acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison}, psychic, or sonic, chosen by you when you activate the effect), the barrier takes the damage instead. If this damage reduces the barrier to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, the creature take any remaining damage.

entries.name: Physical Barrier
entries: You {@spell Project|sw5e-phb|project} a physical barrier that lasts until the end of your next short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. The barrier has a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the amount rolled on your Potent Aptitude die + half your engineer level. Whenever a creature with this barrier takes damage (one of energy, ion, or kinetic, chosen by you when you activate the effect), the barrier takes the damage instead. If this damage reduces the barrier to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, the creature take any remaining damage.

subclassFeature.name: Versatile Direction
entries: You can take a second {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on each of your turns. You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Versatile Direction
entries: You can take a second {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on each of your turns. You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Versatile Direction
entries: You can take a second {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on each of your turns. You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Versatile Direction
entries: You can take a second {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on each of your turns. You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Reinforced Barriers
entries: When you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} while you have a barrier active, you can restore {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to the barrier, provided it is within 30 feet of you. You restore a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to twice the power's level, or 1 hit point for an at-will power. This can't increase a barrier's {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} above its initial {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}. If you have multiple barriers active, you can divide these {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} between them as you see fit.

subclassFeature.name: Adaptive Barrier
entries: When a creature who has one of your barriers within 30 feet of you that you can see takes damage, and that damage is of a type that could be affected by that barrier, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to grant them {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to the triggering damage. If that damage is the same type as the barrier's chosen damage, you instead grant them immunity. Whether {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} or immunity, the barrier immediately drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}.

subclassFeature.name: Gadgeteer Modifications
entries: The modifications are presented in alphabetical order.

entries.name: Advanced Grounding System
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 13th level, Prototype Grounding System} While wearing your gadgeteer harness you have immunity to lightning damage.

entries.name: Auto-Injection Regenerator
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You install a special kolto injector into your gadgeteer harness that can inject you with kolto in response to pain. When you take damage, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend a Hit Die to regain health as long as the damage would not reduce your {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to 0.

entries.name: Autothrusters
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Jet Pack} You can take the Dash and Disengage actions as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} while your jet pack is active.

entries.name: Climbing Gloves
entries: You craft a set of gloves with a powerful assisted grip. While wearing these gloves, you have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 20 feet, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} and Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve climbing.

entries.name: Darkvision Goggles
entries: You craft a pair of sight-enhancing goggles. While wearing these goggles, you have {@spell Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision} to a range of 60 feet. If you already have {@spell Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision}, this modification increases its range by 30 feet.

entries.name: Extended Tank
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level, Jet Pack} Your jet pack now lasts up to 10 minutes when activated.

entries.name: Flame Vents
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level, Jet Pack} You learn the {@i flame sweep} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} and can cast it at first level without using tech points. Once you have used this ability, you cannot use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
Additionally, while your jet pack is active, you can cast {@i flame sweep} using your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} instead of your action.

entries.name: Frailcasting Inhibitor
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You gain a +1 bonus to the tech save DC of powers you cast that requires a Strength or Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Grounding System
entries: While wearing your gadgeteer harness you are immune to the {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked} condition.

entries.name: Integrated Amplifier
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You gain a +1 bonus to melee tech {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Integrated Rangefinder
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You gain a +1 bonus to ranged tech {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Intelligence Core Override
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level} You can cast the {@i override interface} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} at 5th level without spending tech points.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Jet Pack
entries: You integrate a jet pack into your gadgeteer harness to grant you temporary, limited flight. Activating or deactivating the jets requires a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} and, while active, you have a flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.
The jet pack last for 1 minute before deactivating. Once the jets have been activated, they can't be activated again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
Your jet pack's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases to 40 feet at 5th level, 50 feet at 9th level, 60 feet at 13th level, 70 feet at 17th level, and 80 feet at 20th level.

entries.name: Mechanical Arm
entries: You create a mechanical arm which mounts to your shoulder, which you can use independently. You can only gain the benefit of items held by two of your arms at any given time.
You can choose this modification twice.

entries.name: Mimicker
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level} You create a device that attaches to your gadgeteer harness. Your mimicker casts a shadow that makes you appear to be standing in a place near your actual location, causing any creature to have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against you. If you take damage, the property ceases to function for 1 minute. Your mimicker is suppressed while you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb}, {@condition Restrained|sw5e-phb}, or otherwise unable to move.

entries.name: Miniaturized Hydraulics
entries: Your gadgeteer harness can store 20 pounds of equipment without adding to your encumbrance.

entries.name: Oil Spill
