entries: As an action, you can cast the {@i oil slick} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} without expending tech points. When you cast the power in this way, the oil will remain in place for the full duration of the power.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Powered Grappling Hook
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level, Wrist-Mounted {@item Grappling hook|sw5e-phb|Grappling Hook}} While your wrist-mounted {@item Grappling hook|sw5e-phb|grappling hook} is deployed, when you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} with a range of touch, your hook can deliver the power as if it had cast it.

entries.name: Prototype Grounding System
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level, Grounding System} While wearing your gadgeteer harness you have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to lightning damage.

entries.name: Rendcasting Inhibitor
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You gain a +1 bonus to the tech save DC of powers you cast that requires a Dexterity or Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Quick Start Engine
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level, Jet Pack} You can now activate your Jet Pack as an object interaction rather than as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Recycled Adrenals
entries: You can augment a single adrenal to regain its {@optfeature Charge|sw5e-phb|charge}. This adrenal can only be used by you, and it can only affect you. Once you've used this adrenal, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Recycled Explosives
entries: You can augment a single explosive to regain its {@optfeature Charge|sw5e-phb|charge}. This explosive can only be used by you, and it uses your tech save DC instead of its own, unless its own DC would be higher. Once you've used this explosive, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Recycled Stimpacs
entries: You can augment a single stimpac to regain its {@optfeature Charge|sw5e-phb|charge}. This stimpac can only be used by you, and it can only affect you. Once you've used this stimpac, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Sentry Turret
entries: You learn how to craft small sentry turrets shaped like globes that can adhere to any surface. As an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} (your choice), you can throw a sentry to a point you can see within range (30 feet + your Strength modifier x 5). At the end of each of your turns, a deployed sentry automatically targets a hostile creature within 10 feet of it. If multiple targets are available, one is chosen at random. The target must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, it takes 1d4 energy damage and gains 1 {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} level until the end of your next turn. If a creature would be targeted by more than one of these sentries, it only makes this {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} once, taking an additional {@dice d4} damage for each sentry beyond the first.

The sentries have 1 hit point, an {@variantrule Armor Class|sw5e-phb|armor class} of 10, and can be repaired over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. Each sentry lasts for 1 minute before deactivating. You can maintain a number of sentries equal to your Intelligence modifier. Once a sentry has been activated, it can't be activated again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Shocking Hook
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level, Wrist-Mounted {@item Grappling hook|sw5e-phb|Grappling Hook}} After hitting a creature with your {@item Grappling hook|sw5e-phb|grappling hook}, you can use the connection to deliver an at-will {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can cast an at-will {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} at the target with a range of touch. If the power requires an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}. If the target requires a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.
Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you recover the hook.

entries.name: Stealth Field Generator
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level} You create an augmented belt that functions as a portable, personal cloaking device. Activating or deactivating the generator requires a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} and, while active, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb}) {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} that rely on sight. The generator lasts for 1 minute. This effect ends early if you make an attack or cast a force- or tech- power.
Once the belt has been activated, it can't be activated again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Shocking Barrier
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You enhanced your barriers. Whenever a creature with one of your barriers active takes damage from a creature within 5 feet of it, the damaged creature can roll your Potent Aptitude die, dealing the result of the die as lightning damage to the creature that damaged it.

entries.name: Truesight Goggles
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 11th level, {@spell Darkvision|sw5e-phb} Goggles} You modify your goggles with a toggle allowing you to briefly gain enhanced sight. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can activate the truesight feature of your goggles. When toggled on, for the next minute your goggles now automatically dispel illusions and can {@spell Detect Invisibility|sw5e-phb|detect invisibility}, as with truesight.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Weapon Integration
entries: You can integrate a single weapon that weighs no more than 8 lb. into your gadgeteer harness. While integrated, that weapon gains the hidden and fixed properties.

entries.name: Withercasting Inhibitor
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You gain a +1 bonus to the tech save DC of powers you cast that requires a Wisdom or Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Wrist-Mounted Grappling Hook
entries: You craft a wrist-mounted {@item Grappling hook|sw5e-phb|grappling hook} weapon attached to a tightly coiled cord. With this contraption, you can make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} with a range of 30/60. On a hit, it deals 1d4 kinetic damage. This attack can target a surface, object, or creature.

A creature struck by this attack is impaled by the hook. As an action, a creature can attempt to remove the hook. Removing the hook requires a Strength check. While the hook is stuck in the target, you are connected to the target by a 60 foot cable.

While the hook is deployed, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to activate the reel, pulling yourself to the location if the target is your size or larger. A creature or object smaller than you is pulled to you. Alternatively, you can opt to {@spell Release|sw5e-phb|release} the cable (no action required).
Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you recover and reinsert the hook as an action.

subclassFeature.name: Unstable Engineering
entries: Those engineers who choose the Unstable Engineering discipline create and use untested combinations, resulting in powerful—and often unpredictable—effects.

subclassFeature.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: You gain proficiency in your choice of artisan's implements. Additionally, when you engage in crafting with {@item Tinker's implements|sw5e-phb|tinker's implements}, the rate at which you craft doubles.

subclassFeature.name: Modified Tinkercannon
entries: You learn to enhance your {@item Tinker's implements|sw5e-phb|tinker's implements} with unstable science, modifying them into a harness with a cannon. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can modify your {@item Tinker's implements|sw5e-phb|tinker's implements} to create a tinkercannon. You must have {@item Tinker's implements|sw5e-phb|tinker's implements} in order to {@optfeature Perform|sw5e-phb|perform} this modification.

Whenever you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of 1st level or higher while wielding your tinkercannon, you risk unexpected complications. Your GM can have you roll a {@dice d20}. If you roll a 1, roll on the Unstable Engineering Surge table to create a random effect.

Additionally, your tinkercannon come equipped with four overrides, and they gain more at higher levels, as shown in the Modification Slots column of the engineer table. Each time you trigger an Unstable Engineering Surge, you can use an override to reroll the percentile dice. You must use the new result, you can only do this once per surge, and each time you do so in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} (resetting on a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}) your maximum tech points is reduced by 1 until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. You regain all expended overrides when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Modified Tinkercannon
entries: You learn to enhance your {@item Tinker's implements|sw5e-phb|tinker's implements} with unstable science, modifying them into a harness with a cannon. You regain all expended overrides when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can modify your {@item Tinker's implements|sw5e-phb|tinker's implements} to create a tinkercannon. You must have {@item Tinker's implements|sw5e-phb|tinker's implements} in order to {@optfeature Perform|sw5e-phb|perform} this modification.

Additionally, your tinkercannon come equipped with four overrides, and they gain more at higher levels, as shown in the Modification Slots column of the engineer table. Each time you trigger an Unstable Engineering Surge, you can use an override to reroll the percentile dice. You must use the new result, you can only do this once per surge, and each time you do so in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} (resetting on a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}) your maximum tech points is reduced by 1 until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. You regain all expended overrides when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Unstable Volley
entries: While wielding your tinkercannon, as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} you can expend one use of your Potent Aptitude to launch a volley of unstable energy at a surface located within 30 feet of you that you can see. This energy adheres to the surface for 1 minute, after which it erupts. As a part of this {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, or as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on a following turn, you can cause the energy to erupt early. Each creature within 5 feet of it must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your tech save DC. A creature takes 1d6 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successfu one.
The range at which you can launch your volley increases to 60 feet at 9th level, and 120 feet at 17th level.
This damage increases when you reach certain levels in this class, increasing to 2d6 at 5th level, 3d6 at 11th level, and 4d6 at 17th level.

entries: While wielding your tinkercannon, as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} you can expend one use of your Potent Aptitude to launch a volley of unstable energy at a surface located within 30 feet of you that you can see. This energy adheres to the surface for 1 minute, after which it erupts. As a part of this {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, or as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on a following turn, you can cause the energy to erupt early. A creature takes 1d6 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successfu one.
The range at which you can launch your volley increases to 60 feet at 9th level, and 120 feet at 17th level.
This damage increases when you reach certain levels in this class, increasing to 2d6 at 5th level, 3d6 at 11th level, and 4d6 at 17th level.

This energy adheres to the surface for 1 minute, after which it erupts. subclassFeature.name: Creative Destruction
entries: You can add your governing ability modifier (minimum of +1) to any damage you deal with {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} and class features that don't already include that modifier. If the {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} or class feature would damage multiple creatures, you can only deal this additional damage to one of them.
If you choose to deal this additional damage, your GM can have you roll on the Unstable Engineering Surge table.

subclassFeature.name: Experimental Overrides
entries: You gain a modicum of control over your surges. Whenever you roll on the Unstable Engineering Surge table and use one of your overrides, you can choose either total.

subclassFeature.name: Engineering Bombardment
entries: The harmful energies of your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} and class features intensify. When you roll damage for a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} or class feature and roll the highest number possible on any of the dice, you can roll it again and use both results. You can only use this ability once per {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} or class feature.

rows: Roll on this table at the start of each of your turns for 1 minute, ignoring this result on subsequent rolls.
For the next minute, you can see any {@condition Invisible|sw5e-phb|invisible} creature if you have line of sight to it.
A DRK-1 tracker droid appears with 5 feet of you, then disappears 1 minute later.
You cast {@i explosion} at 3rd-level centered on yourself without expending tech points.
You cast {@i homing rockets} at 5th-level without expending tech points.
Roll a {@dice d10}. Your height changes by a number of inches equal to the roll: if odd, you shrink; if even, you grow.
You fall asleep standing for 1 minute or until you take damage.
For the next minute, you regain 5 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} at the start of each of your turns
You grow a long beard made of feathers that remains until you sneeze.
You cast {@i oil slick} centered on yourself without expending tech points.
Creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the first {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} they make against you in the next minute.
Your skin turns a vibrant shade of blue. Any effect that ends a curse ends this.
You grow an extra eye, granting {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on sight for 1 minute.
For the next minute, all your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} with a casting time of 1 action have a casting time of 1 {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.
You teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see.
You take 2d10 lightning damage and are {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked} for 1 minute.
Maximize the damage of the next damaging {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you cast within the next minute.
Roll a {@dice d10}. Your age changes by a number of years equal to the roll: if odd, younger; if even, older.
You start running uncontrollably for 1 minute, moving your entire {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} each turn.
Each creature within 30 feet of you is subjected to the {@i gleaming outline} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} for 1 minute.
For the next minute, you can teleport up to 20 feet as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on each of your turns.
You are {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded} and {@condition Deafened|sw5e-phb|deafened} for 1 minute.

You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the first {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} you make each turn for 1 minute.
You can't speak for the next minute. Whenever you try, pink bubbles float out of your mouth.
A shimmering energy barrier grants you a +2 bonus to AC for 1 minute.
You are immune to being intoxicated by alcohol for the next 5d6 days.
Your hair falls out but grows back within 24 hours. If you don't have hair, you instead grow it for 24 hours.
For 1 minute, any flammable object not worn or carried you touch bursts into flame.
You regain tech points equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one).
For the next minute, you shout whenever you speak.
You cast {@i smoke cloud} centered on yourself without expending tech points.
Up to three creatures you choose within 30 feet of you take 4d10 lightning damage.
You are {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb} by the nearest creature until the end of your next turn.
Each creature within 30 feet of you becomes {@condition Invisible|sw5e-phb|invisible} for 1 minute, or until it attacks or casts a power.
You gain {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to all damage for the next minute.
A random creature within 60 feet of you becomes {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb} for 1d4 hours.
You emit bright light in a 30-foot radius for 1 minute.
Each creature within 30 feet of you except you gains the benefits of {@i mirror image} for 1 minute.
Illusory butterflies and flower petals flutter in the air within 10 feet of you for the next minute.
You can take one additional action immediately.
Each creature within 30 feet of you takes 1d10 necrotic damage and you gain {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the damage.
You cast {@i mirror image} without expending tech points.
You are frozen in {@spell Carbonite|sw5e-phb|carbonite} and {@condition Paralyzed|sw5e-phb|paralyzed} for 1 minute or until you take damage.
You turn {@condition Invisible|sw5e-phb|invisible} and can't make sound for 1 minute, or until you attack or cast a power.
If you die within the next minute, you immediately come back to life as if by the {@i defibrillate} power.
Your size increases by one size category for the next minute.
You and all creatures within 30 feet of you gain vulnerability to energy damage for the next minute.
You are surrounded by faint, ethereal music for the next minute.
You regain half your expended tech points.

subclassFeature.name: Assault Specialist
entries: Those fighters who choose to become Assault Specialists focus on the development of raw physical power honed to deadly perfection. Assault Specialists combine rigorous training with physical excellence to deal devastating blows.

subclassFeature.name: Brute Force
entries: When you make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you gain a +2 bonus to the damage roll. This bonus increases to +3 at 10th level and +4 at 16th level.

subclassFeature.name: Brute Force
entries: When you make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you gain a +2 bonus to the damage roll. This bonus increases to +3 at 10th level and +4 at 16th level.

subclassFeature.name: Brute Force
entries: When you make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you gain a +2 bonus to the damage roll. This bonus increases to +3 at 10th level and +4 at 16th level.

subclassFeature.name: Improved Critical
entries: Your {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} range with weapons increases by 1.

subclassFeature.name: Remarkable Athlete
entries: You can add half your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} to any Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution check you make that doesn't already use your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}.

subclassFeature.name: Brutish Durability
entries: Once per round, you can roll a {@dice d8} and add the die to a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} you make. If applying this bonus to a {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|death saving throw} increases the total to 20 or higher, you gain the benefits of rolling a 20 on the {@dice d20}.
This die increases to a {@dice d10} at 13th level and a {@dice d12} at 17th level.

subclassFeature.name: Brutish Durability
entries: Once per round, you can roll a {@dice d8} and add the die to a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} you make. If applying this bonus to a {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|death saving throw} increases the total to 20 or higher, you gain the benefits of rolling a 20 on the {@dice d20}.
This die increases to a {@dice d10} at 13th level and a {@dice d12} at 17th level.

subclassFeature.name: Brutish Durability
entries: Once per round, you can roll a {@dice d8} and add the die to a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} you make. If applying this bonus to a {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|death saving throw} increases the total to 20 or higher, you gain the benefits of rolling a 20 on the {@dice d20}.
This die increases to a {@dice d10} at 13th level and a {@dice d12} at 17th level.

subclassFeature.name: Devastating Critical
entries: When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you gain a bonus to that weapon's damage roll equal to your fighter level.

subclassFeature.name: Survivor
entries: You attain the pinnacle of resilience in battle. At the start of each of your turns, you regain {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier if you have no more than half your {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} left. You don't gain this benefit if you have 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}.

subclassFeature.name: Blademaster Specialist
entries: Those fighters who choose to become Blademaster Specialists hone their focus to a blade's edge, becoming so in tune with their arsenal that it becomes both their weapon and their armor.

subclassFeature.name: Unarmored Defense
entries: While you are wearing no armor and not wielding a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}, your AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Strength modifier.

subclassFeature.name: Adaptive Fighting
entries: You've learned to make adaptations to your fighting style on the fly. You have three such effects: Change Up, Draw, and Stow. When you use your Adaptive Fighting, you choose which effect to create.
You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Change Up
entries: You can use your object interaction and expend a use of your Adaptive Fighting to change the Fighting Style option granted to you by your fighter class feature.

entries.name: Draw
entries: When you use your object interaction to draw one or more weapons, you can expend a use of your Adaptive Fighting (no action required) to increase your {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} range by 1 with the weapon(s) until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Stow
entries: When you use your object interaction to stow a weapon, you can expend a use of your Adaptive Fighting (no action required) to take the {@action Disengage|sw5e-phb} action.

subclassFeature.name: Dervish
entries: When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you regain an expended use of your Adaptive Fighting.

subclassFeature.name: Resilient Fighting
entries: When you expend a use of your Adaptive Fighting, you gain {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to energy and kinetic damage dealt by weapons until the start of your next turn.

subclassFeature.name: Adrenaline Rush
entries: When you use your Action Surge feature, you can take an extra {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on top of the additional action.

subclassFeature.name: Bladestorm
entries: You can use your action to make a single {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} against each creature within your reach. Make a separate {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} against each target. The first attack gains a +1 bonus to its {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, and each attack after the first gains an additional +1 bonus to its {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, cumulatively, to a maximum bonus of +6. If you are wielding two light- or vibro-weapons, or a weapon with the double property, you also add this bonus to your damage rolls, and you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to engage in Double- or Two-Weapon Fighting.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

subclassFeature.name: Shield Specialist
entries: Those fighters who choose to become Shield Specialists train to bolster those around them. They can inspire their allies with renewed vigor while simultaneously protecting them from harm.

subclassFeature.name: Techcasting
entries: You have derived powers from schematics with the aid of your {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad}. See {@book chapter 10|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} for the general rules of {@book techcasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} and {@book chapter 12|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} for the {@book tech powers list|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

entries.name: Tech Powers Known
entries: You learn 3 {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of your choice, and you learn more at higher levels, as shown in the {@book Tech Powers Known|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} column of the Shield {@feat Specialist|sw5e-phb} {@book techcasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} table. You may not learn a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of a level higher than your Max Power Level.

entries.name: Tech Points
entries: You have a number of tech points equal to half your fighter level, as shown in the Tech Points column of the Shield {@feat Specialist|sw5e-phb} {@book techcasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} table, + your Intelligence modifier. You use these tech points to cast {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. You regain all expended tech points when you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Max Power Level
entries: Many {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} can be overcharged, consuming more tech points to create a greater effect. You can overcharge these powers to a maximum level, which increases at higher levels, as shown in the Max Power Level column of the Shield {@feat Specialist|sw5e-phb} {@book techcasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} table.
You may only cast {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} at 4th-level once. You regain the ability to do so after a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Techcasting Ability
entries: Intelligence is your {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} for your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. You use your Intelligence whenever a power refers to your {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability}. Additionally, you use your Intelligence modifier when setting the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} DC for a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you cast and when making an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} with one.
{@b Tech save DC} = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Intelligence modifier
{@b Tech attack modifier} = your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Intelligence modifier

entries.name: Techcasting Focus
entries: You use a {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} (found in {@book chapter 5|sw5e-phb|5}) as a tech focus for your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

subclassFeature.name: Stay in Formation
entries: You can take the {@action Guard|sw5e-phb} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on your turn.

subclassFeature.name: Rallying Cry
entries: When you use your Second Wind feature, you can choose up to three allies within 60 feet of you that can see or hear you. Each ally regains {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your fighter level.

entries.name: Shield Specialist Techcasting
entries: You can choose an additional ally at 9th, 13th, and 17th level.

subclassFeature.name: Inspiring Surge
entries: When you use your Action Surge feature, you can choose one creature within 60 feet of you that is allied with you. That creature can make one melee or ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} with its {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb}, provided that it can see or hear you.

subclassFeature.name: Bulwark
entries: You can extend the benefit of your Indomitable feature to an ally. When you decide to use Indomitable to reroll an Intelligence, a Wisdom, or a Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} and you aren't {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb}, you can choose one ally within 60 feet of you that also failed its {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against the same effect. If that creature can see or hear you, it can reroll its {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} and must use the new roll.

subclassFeature.name: Greater Inspiring Surge
entries: You can choose two allies within 60 feet of you, rather than one, when you using your Inspiring Surge feature.

subclassFeature.name: Tactical Specialist
entries: Those fighters who choose to become Tactical Specialists employ martial techniques passed down through generations. To a Tactical {@feat Specialist|sw5e-phb}, combat is an academic field, sometimes including subjects beyond battle such as armstech or armormech. Not every fighter absorbs the lessons of history, theory, and artistry that are reflected in the Tactical Specialty, but those who do are well-rounded fighters of great skill and knowledge.

subclassFeature.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: You gain proficiency in your choice of artisan's implements.

subclassFeature.name: Improved Combat Superiority
entries: Your tactical skill in combat improves, granting bonuses to your Combat Superiority.

entries.name: Improved Maneuvers
entries: You know four {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} of your choice, instead of two, and you earn more at higher levels, as shown in the Maneuvers Known column of the {@spell Tactical Superiority|sw5e-phb} table.

entries.name: Improved Superiority Dice
entries: You have four {@book superiority dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers}, instead of two, and you earn more at higher levels, as shown in the {@book Superiority Dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} Quantity column of the {@spell Tactical Superiority|sw5e-phb} table.

subclassFeature.name: Maneuver Versatility
entries: You can use each {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} twice per turn, instead of once.

Additionally, choose two {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} you know. The chosen {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} count as {@book general maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|General} for you. You can choose another {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. Whenever you gain a level in this class, you can replace one of these {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} with another {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} you know.

subclassFeature.name: Know Your Enemy
entries: If you spend at least 1 minute observing or interacting with another creature outside combat, you can learn certain information about its capabilities compared to your own. The GM tells you if the creature is your equal, superior, or inferior in regard to two of the following characteristics of your choice:

items: Strength score
Dexterity score
Constitution score
{@variantrule Armor Class|sw5e-phb}
Current {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}
Total class levels (if any)
Fighter class levels (if any)

subclassFeature.name: Maneuver Adept
entries: Once per turn, your {@book superiority dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} rolls gain a minimum roll threshold, discussed in chapter 7.

subclassFeature.name: Relentless
entries: When you roll {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} and have no {@book superiority dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} remaining, you regain 1 superiority die.

subclassFeature.name: Maneuver Mastery
entries: Once per round, when you would roll a superiority die, you can instead choose the maximum.

subclassFeature.name: Makashi Form
entries: {@optfeature Makashi Form|sw5e-phb}, also known as Contention Form, encourages precision and efficiency over power, using jabs, parries and light cuts over slashes, blocks and chops. Those guardians who focus on {@optfeature Makashi Form|sw5e-phb} utilize calculated blade manipulation, intense focus, and expert timing to confuse and trap their opponents.

subclassFeature.name: Form Basics
entries: You gain the Makashi {@book lightsaber form, detailed in chapter 6|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}. If you already know this form, you can instead choose another {@book lightsaber form|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}.

subclassFeature.name: The Way of the Ysalamiri
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can enter an offensive stance for one minute. While in this stance, you add your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice) to the first {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} and damage rolls you make each turn.
This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Channel the Force
entries: You gain the following Channel the Force option.

entries.name: Makashi Riposte
entries: When another creature damages you with a melee attack, you can expend a use of your Channel the Force and use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to attempt to deflect the attack. When you do so, the damage you take from the attack is reduced by 1d10 + your Dexterity modifier + your guardian level.
If you reduce the damage to 0, you can immediately make a single {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} against that creature as a part of the {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb}.

subclassFeature.name: Force-Empowered Reflexes
entries: You can take a second {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} each round.

subclassFeature.name: Glancing Blow
entries: When an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to halve the attack's damage against you.

subclassFeature.name: Master of Contention
entries: You are a duelist of the highest caliber.  Your Dexterity and Wisdom or Charisma scores (your choice) increase by 2. Your maximum for those scores increases by 2. Additionally, you can use your action to gain the following benefits for 1 minute:

items: You have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to kinetic and energy damage, and you ignore {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to kinetic and energy damage.
All melee attacks have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} against you.
Your melee weapon attacks inflict an additional damage die.

entries: This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Niman Form
entries: {@optfeature Niman Form|sw5e-phb}, also known as Moderation Form, strikes a balance between bladework and {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}. Those guardians who focus on {@optfeature Niman Form|sw5e-phb} weave Force manipulation with their melee weapon strikes, pushing their opponents off-balance to create an opening.

subclassFeature.name: Form Basics
entries: You gain the Niman {@book lightsaber form, detailed in chapter 6|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}. If you already know this form, you can instead choose another {@book lightsaber form|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}.

subclassFeature.name: The Way of the Rancor
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can enter a balanced stance for one minute. As a part of this {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, and as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on each of your turns, when you use your action to cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, you can make one {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}. Additionally, for the duration, you can use Wisdom or Charisma instead of Strength or Dexterity for the attack and damage rolls of your melee weapon attacks. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.
This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Channel the Force
entries: You gain the following Channel the Force option.

entries.name: Telekinetic Slash
entries: When you deal damage with an at-will {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} that requires a force attack or a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can expend a use of your Channel the Force and expend force points to deal additional damage to the target, which is the same type as the power's damage. The additional damage is 1d8 for each point spent in this way. You can't deal more additional damage than the amount shown in the Focused Strikes column of the guardian table.

subclassFeature.name: Enlightenment
entries: When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} with a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, or you restore {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to a friendly creature that is at 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} with a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, you gain temporary force points equal to your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of one). Once you've done so, you can't do so again until you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Redirect
entries: When you would be affected by a weapon or {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} that requires a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} and would affect only you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to redirect that power to another target within 30 feet. If the weapon or power required a melee or ranged attack, make a melee or ranged force attack against the new target, as appropriate. If it required a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, the new target must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your universal force save DC.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

subclassFeature.name: Master of Moderation
entries: The Force flows in perfect concert with your weapon attacks. Your Dexterity and Wisdom or Charisma scores (your choice) increase by 2. Your maximum for these scores increases by 2. Additionally, you can use your action to gain the following benefits for 1 minute:

items: You have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to kinetic and energy damage from unenhanced weapons.

You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}. Additionally, you have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} against the damage of {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

When you use your action to cast an at-will {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} that targets only one creature, you can target an additional creature within 5 feet of the original target and within the power's range.

entries: This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Shien/Djem So Form
entries: Shien/{@optfeature Djem So Form|sw5e-phb}, also known as Perseverance Form, utilizes a force-enhanced strength to overwhelm opponents. Those guardians who focus on Shien/{@optfeature Djem So Form|sw5e-phb} actively attempt to force an opening rather than waiting for the opportunity to present itself.

subclassFeature.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: You gain proficiency in {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}.

subclassFeature.name: Form Basics
entries: You gain your choice of the Shien or Djem So {@book lightsaber form, detailed in chapter 6|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}. If you already know the chosen form, you can instead choose another {@book lightsaber form|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}.

subclassFeature.name: The Way of the Krayt Dragon
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can take a {@feat Threatening|sw5e-phb|threatening} stance for one minute. While in this stance, the first time you hit with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} using Strength each turn, you can choose to deal additional damage equal to your Strength modifier. If there is another creature within 5 feet of the original target and within your reach, you can attempt to deal the additional damage to that creature instead. If the original {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} would hit the second creature, it takes damage equal to your Strength modifier. The damage is of the same type dealt by the original attack.
This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Channel the Force
entries: You gain one of the following Channel the Force options. Choose Blade Barrier for Shien or Falling Avalanche for Djem So.

entries.name: Blade Barrier
entries: On your turn, when you deal melee weapon damage that includes your Strength modifier, you can forgo your Strength modifier to the damage roll, expend a use of your Channel the Force (no action required), and reduce your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} by half. If you do so, energy and kinetic damage you take from weapons before the end of your next turn is reduced by an amount equal to your Strength modifier. You can not use this feature if you have moved more than half your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} this turn.

entries.name: Falling Avalanche
entries: On your turn, you can expend a use of your Channel the Force (no action required) and reduce your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} by half to gain {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the next {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} or {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} you make using Strength before the end of your next turn. You can not use this feature if you have moved more than half your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} this turn.

subclassFeature.name: Determination
entries: You gain one of the following features. Choose Aggressive Negotiations for Shien or Reliable Vigor for Djem So.

entries.name: Aggressive Negotiations
entries: You gain proficiency in {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}. Additionally, while you are wielding a weapon with which you are proficient, you can't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on Charisma ({@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb}) and Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}) checks, and if the target would make a contested check, they can't have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on it.

entries.name: Reliable Vigor
entries: If the {@dice d20} result for a Strength check or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} is less than your guardian level, you can use your guardian level in place of the result. You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Presence
entries: You gain one of the following features. Choose Precise Reflection for Shien or Brutal Strikes for Djem So.

entries.name: Precise Reflection
entries: When you hit with an attack made by the {@i saber reflect} power, you can expend force points to deal additional damage to the target, which is the same type as the weapon's damage. The additional damage is 1d8 for each point spent in this way. You can't deal more additional damage than the amount shown in the Focused Strikes column of the guardian table.

entries.name: Brutal Strikes
entries: The Force flowing through you grants you incredible strength. Your Force-Empowered Strikes and Improved Force-Empowered Strikes damage rolls gain a minimum roll threshold, discussed in chapter 7. Additionally, when you spend force points to use your Force-Empowered Strikes feature, you gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to twice the number of points spent.

subclassFeature.name: Master of Perseverance
entries: Your might overwhelms even the most implacable of foes. Your Strength and Constitution scores increase by 2. Your maximum for these scores increases by 2. Additionally, you can use your action to gain the following benefits for 1 minute:

items: You have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to kinetic and energy damage from unenhanced weapons.

Once per turn, when you hit with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} using Strength, you can use your Force-Empowered Strikes feature at 1st-level without expending force points. You gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the extra damage dealt.

When a creature within 5 feet of you makes an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} against you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to make a single {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} with {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} against that creature. If the attack hits, you impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the triggering {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}.

entries: This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Soresu Form
entries: {@optfeature Soresu Form|sw5e-phb}, also known as Resilience Form, relies on tight bladework and subtle dodges to provide maximum defensive coverage, minimizing exposure to ranged weaponry. Those guardians who focus on {@optfeature Soresu Form|sw5e-phb} use broad footwork to move around the playing field, making broad, short sweeping motions that protect the body.

subclassFeature.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: You gain proficiency in {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}.

subclassFeature.name: Form Basics
entries: You gain the Soresu {@book lightsaber form, detailed in chapter 6|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}. If you already know this form, you can instead choose another {@book lightsaber form|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}.

subclassFeature.name: The Way of the Mynock
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can enter a defensive stance for one minute. As a part of this {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, and as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on each of your turns, you can cast the {@i saber ward} power. When you do so, you have a number of special reactions equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} that you can only use to cast the {@i saber reflect} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.
This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Channel the Force
entries: You gain the following Channel the Force option.

entries.name: Advancing Defender
entries: When you cast the {@i saber reflect} power, you can expend a use of your Channel the Force to move up to 10 feet as a part of that same {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb}. This movement does not provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks}.

subclassFeature.name: Circle of Shelter
entries: You learn to fend off strikes directed at you or other creatures nearby. If you or a creature you can see within 5 feet of you is hit by an attack, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to ward the creature if you're wielding a melee weapon or a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}. Roll 1d8 and add the number rolled to the target's AC against that attack. If the attack still hits, the target has {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} against the attack's damage.
You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Circle of Shelter
entries: You learn to fend off strikes directed at you or other creatures nearby. If you or a creature you can see within 5 feet of you is hit by an attack, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to ward the creature if you're wielding a melee weapon or a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}. Roll 1d8 and add the number rolled to the target's AC against that attack. If the attack still hits, the target has {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} against the attack's damage.
You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Circle of Shelter
entries: You learn to fend off strikes directed at you or other creatures nearby. If you or a creature you can see within 5 feet of you is hit by an attack, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to ward the creature if you're wielding a melee weapon or a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}. Roll 1d8 and add the number rolled to the target's AC against that attack. If the attack still hits, the target has {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} against the attack's damage.
You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Circle of Shelter
entries: You learn to fend off strikes directed at you or other creatures nearby. If you or a creature you can see within 5 feet of you is hit by an attack, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to ward the creature if you're wielding a melee weapon or a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}. Roll 1d8 and add the number rolled to the target's AC against that attack. If the attack still hits, the target has {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} against the attack's damage.
You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Stand Against the Tide
entries: When a hostile creature misses you with a melee attack, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to force that creature to repeat the same attack against another creature (other than itself) of your choice.

subclassFeature.name: Master of Resilience
entries: Your presence on the field of battle is an inspiration to your allies. Your Constitution and Wisdom or Charisma scores (your choice) increase by 2. Your maximum for those scores increases by 2. Additionally, you can use your action to gain the following benefits for 1 minute:

items: You have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to kinetic and energy damage from unenhanced weapons.

When you use the {@i saber reflect} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, you can make a single melee attack on an enemy within 5ft of you as a part of that same {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb}.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}, as do your allies within 30 feet of you.

entries: This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Crimson Order
entries: Monks of the Crimson Order are unyielding in their resolve. They pledge themselves to a singular entity or belief, and uphold their service with solemnity and diligence.

subclassFeature.name: Crimson Armaments
entries: You gain proficiency in light and {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor}. If you are already proficient in light and {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor}, you instead gain proficiency in {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}. Additionally, you can now gain the benefits of your Martial Arts and Unarmored Movement features while wearing armor as long as you are not wielding a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}.

Additionally, you've learned to adapt to new weaponry. Over the course of an hour, which can be performed during a {@variantrule Short Rest|sw5e-phb|short rest}, you can {@optfeature Perform|sw5e-phb|perform} a kata with a weapon of your choice. You gain proficiency in that weapon if you do not already have proficiency, and it becomes a monk weapon for you. You can only adapt to one weapon at a time, and if you attempt to adapt to another weapon you immediately lose your proficiency with the chosen weapon.

subclassFeature.name: Crimson Squall
entries: You've learned to enhance your kata. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} while wielding a monk weapon, you can expend 1 focus point to cause the area within 5 feet of you to become {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain} for hostile creatures for 1 minute. This area travels with you, and affected creatures within the area can not make {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks}.
At 11th level, the range of this area increases to 15 feet, and at 17th level, the range of this area increases to 30 feet.

subclassFeature.name: Crimson Squall
entries: You've learned to enhance your kata. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} while wielding a monk weapon, you can expend 1 focus point to cause the area within 5 feet of you to become {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain} for hostile creatures for 1 minute. This area travels with you, and affected creatures within the area can not make {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks}.
At 11th level, the range of this area increases to 15 feet, and at 17th level, the range of this area increases to 30 feet.

subclassFeature.name: Crimson Squall
entries: You've learned to enhance your kata. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} while wielding a monk weapon, you can expend 1 focus point to cause the area within 5 feet of you to become {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain} for hostile creatures for 1 minute. This area travels with you, and affected creatures within the area can not make {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks}.
At 11th level, the range of this area increases to 15 feet, and at 17th level, the range of this area increases to 30 feet.

subclassFeature.name: Vigilant Sentinel
entries: When you attempt to {@optfeature Perceive|sw5e-phb|perceive} your surroundings on your turn, you can opt to not move on that turn. If you avoid moving, you gain a +10 bonus to your Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks until the start of your next turn. You lose this benefit if you move or fall prone, either voluntarily or because of some external effect.

subclassFeature.name: Sovereign Protector
entries: Your mastery of focus has allowed you to unlock your fullest potential in combat. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can gain the following effects for 1 minute.

items: Your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is doubled.
Your AC increases by 2.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}.

You gain an additional action of each of your turns. This action can be used only to take the Attack (one {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} only), Dash, Disengage, Hide, or {@action Use an Object|sw5e-phb} action.

entries: This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Echani Order
entries: Monks of the Echani Order train relentlessly both with and without their weapons, to the point where the weapon becomes an extension of the body. Founded on a mastery of sword fighting, the tradition has expanded to include many different weapons.

subclassFeature.name: Echani Weapons
entries: Your special martial arts training leads you to master the use of certain weapons. You gain the following benefits. Choose two types of weapons to be your Echani weapons: one {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon} and one {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true}. Each of these weapons can be any simple or martial weapon that lacks the special property. You gain proficiency with these weapons if you don't already have it. Weapons of the chosen types are monk weapons for you. Many of this order's features work only with your Echani weapons. When you reach 6th, 11th, and 17th level in this class, you can choose another type of weapon to be an Echani weapon for you, following the criteria above.

entries.name: Agile Parry
entries: If you make an unarmed strike as part of the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action on your turn and are holding an Echani weapon, you can use it to defend yourself if it is a melee weapon. You gain a +2 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, while the weapon is in your hand and you aren't {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Echani's Shot
entries: You can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on your turn to make your ranged attacks with an Echani weapon more deadly. When you do so, any target you hit with a ranged attack using an Echani weapon takes an extra 1d4 damage of the weapon's type. You retain this benefit until the end of the current turn.

subclassFeature.name: One with the Blade
entries: You extend your focus into your Echani weapons, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Enhanced Echani Weapons
entries: Your attacks with your Echani weapons count as enhanced for the purpose of overcoming {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} and immunity to unenhanced attacks and damage.

entries.name: Deft Strike
entries: When you hit a target with an Echani weapon, you can spend 1 focus point to cause the weapon to deal extra damage to the target equal to your Martial Arts die. You can use this feature only once on each of your turns.

subclassFeature.name: Sharpen the Blade
entries: You gain the ability to augment your weapons further with your focus. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can expend up to 3 focus points to grant one Echani weapon you touch a bonus to attack and damage rolls when you attack with it. The bonus equals the number of points you spent. This bonus lasts for 1 minute or until you use this feature again. This feature has no effect on an enhanced weapon that already has a bonus to attack and damage rolls.

subclassFeature.name: Unerring Accuracy
entries: Your mastery of weapons grants you extraordinary accuracy. If you miss with an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} using a monk weapon on your turn, you can reroll it. You can use this feature only once on each of your turns.

subclassFeature.name: Matukai Order
entries: Monks of the Matukai Order center their philosophy around  a balance and harmony between the spiritual Force and the physical body, using exercise as a form of meditation. They channel the Force through their bodies, turning themselves into exceptional warriors.

subclassFeature.name: Force-Enhanced Strikes
entries: You learn to channel the Force into your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} and monk weapons, further enhancing your melee strikes. When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike or {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} with a monk weapon, you can spend 1 focus point to force the creature to make a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your focus save DC. On a failed save, it takes 2d6 force damage and is pushed up to 15 feet away from you. On a successful save, the creature only takes half as much damage and isn't pushed.

subclassFeature.name: Instinctive Leap
entries: When a hostile creatures moves to within 5 feet of you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to disengage and leap up to half your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. If you end this movement in the air, you immediately fall to the ground.

subclassFeature.name: Absorb Damage
entries: You learn to channel the Force into your skin and bones, greatly enhancing your durability. You can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to channel the Force throughout your body. Until the start of your next turn, you have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to kinetic and energy damage.
You can use this feature four times. You gain an additional use at 13th and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Absorb Damage
entries: You learn to channel the Force into your skin and bones, greatly enhancing your durability. You can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to channel the Force throughout your body. Until the start of your next turn, you have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to kinetic and energy damage.
You can use this feature four times. You gain an additional use at 13th and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Absorb Damage
entries: You learn to channel the Force into your skin and bones, greatly enhancing your durability. You can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to channel the Force throughout your body. Until the start of your next turn, you have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to kinetic and energy damage.
You can use this feature four times. You gain an additional use at 13th and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Control the Field
entries: Whenever you use your Instinctive Leap feature, you can leap your entire movement {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} instead of only half. Additionally, when you land, you can make an unarmed strike with {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} against a creature within 5 feet of you as part of the same {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb}. On a hit, this attack deals an additional 2d6 force damage.

subclassFeature.name: Nightsister Order
entries: Monks of the Nightsister Order utilize an innate Force-sensitivity to commune with death. They learn to channel this power to drain the life of their foes to prolong their own existence. Males who join this order are called Nightbrothers.

subclassFeature.name: Ichor Lightning
entries: You gain a new attack option that you can use with the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action. This special attack is a ranged focus attack with a range of 30 feet. You are proficient with it, and you add your focus ability modifier to its attack and damage rolls. Its damage is necrotic, it counts as an unarmed strike for the sake of your Martial Arts feature, and it uses your Martial Arts die for its damage die.
When you would make an unarmed strike as part of your Martial Arts {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} attack or your Flurry of Blows, you can replace the attack with this one.

When you reduce a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} with this attack, you gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your focus ability modifier (your choice, minimum of one) + your monk level.

subclassFeature.name: Dark Magick
entries: You can use your action to force each creature within 30 feet of you that can see you to make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your focus save DC or be {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} or {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb} (your choice) of you until the end of your next turn.

subclassFeature.name: Mastery of Death
entries: When you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, you can expend 1 focus point (no action required) to have 1 hit point instead.

subclassFeature.name: Spirit Blade Assault
entries: As an action, you conjure a blade of spirit energy and strike one creature within 5 feet of you with it, expending 1 to 10 focus points. The target must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your focus save DC. On a failed save, it takes 2d10 necrotic damage per focus point spent, or half as much on a successful one.

subclassFeature.name: Acquisitions Practice
entries: Many operatives are hired for the procurement of valuable artifacts, but only the true masters of the art can slip through the tightest security and make off with untold riches, whether they do it for a profit, or for sport. Those operatives who choose the Acquisitions Practice apply a mixture of stealth and impressive acrobatics to surpass any kind of defenses they are met with.

subclassFeature.name: Fast and Agile
entries: You can use the {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} granted by your Cunning Action to make a Dexterity ({@skill Sleight Of Hand|sw5e-phb}) check, use your {@item Demolitions kit|sw5e-phb|demolitions kit} or {@item Security kit|sw5e-phb|security kit} to disarm a trap or open a lock, or take the {@action Use an Object|sw5e-phb} action.

Additionally, climbing no longer costs you extra movement, and you gain the ability to move in flying leaps with incredible {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}, precision, and power. When you move, instead of using your walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}, you may take two short movements by flying. Each movement is at half your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}, and you must end each one on a solid object, a surface, or on the ground. If you do not, you fall and your movement ends. If you Dash, your bonus movement is applied to your normal {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}, not this movement.

subclassFeature.name: Deft Hands
entries: You learn a number of techniques to distract and confuse your opponents. When you deal Sneak Attack damage, you may choose to forgo two of your Sneak Attack dice to {@optfeature Perform|sw5e-phb|perform} a deft hand {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers}.

Some of your deft hand {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} require your target to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist the deft hand {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers}'s effects. The {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} DC is as follows:
{@b Deft Hands save DC} = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Dexterity modifier

entries.name: Hinder
entries: You attempt to distract your target in order to hinder their movement. The target must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, it gains 1 {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} level until the end of its next turn and it makes the first Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} before the end of its next turn with {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

entries.name: Pilfer
entries: You attempt to pick your target's pockets. The target must make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the first Dexterity ({@skill Sleight Of Hand|sw5e-phb}) check you make against the target before the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Tumble
entries: You attempt to nimbly roll away. You immediately move 10 feet in a direction of your choice, and the target must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, this movement does not provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks} from the creature.

subclassFeature.name: Supreme Sneak
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on a Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb}) check if you move no more than half your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} on the same turn. Additionally, as long as you aren't {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb}, you no longer take damage from falling less than 100 feet, and have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to falling damage.

subclassFeature.name: Aerial Agility
entries: Your agility in the air grants you the following benefits:

items: When you move, you can instead take 3 short movements by flying.
Whenever you end your flying movement and you are within 5 feet of a climbable surface, you can grab onto that surface as though you were climbing upon it.

subclassFeature.name: Thief's Reflexes
entries: You can take two turns during the first round of any combat. You take your first turn at your normal {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} and your second turn at your {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} minus 10. You can't use this feature when you are surprised.

Additionally, you learn to utilize the momentum of your fall to make deadly vertical strikes. Whenever you fall at least 50 feet and land within 5 feet of an enemy creature you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to make one {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} against that creature. If the attack is a Sneak Attack, you can deal three additional weapon dice worth of damage and the creature must succeed on a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your Deft Hands save DC or be knocked prone.

subclassFeature.name: Beguiler Practice
entries: Those operatives who choose the Beguiler Practice augment their natural wiles and charm with subtle utilization of the Force. They tap into these powers to cloud the minds of their foes, distracting and diverting before abruptly dispatching them.

subclassFeature.name: Forcecasting
entries: You have derived powers from your emotional connection to the Force. See {@book chapter 10|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} for the general rules of {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} and {@book chapter 11|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} for the {@book force powers list|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

entries.name: Force Powers Known
entries: You learn 4 {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of your choice, and you learn more at higher levels, as shown in the {@book Force Powers Known|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} column of the Beguiler Practice {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} table. You may not learn a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of a level higher than your Max Power Level, and you may learn a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} at the same time you learn its prerequisite.

entries.name: Force Points
entries: You have a number of force points equal to your operative level, as shown in the Force Points column of the Beguiler Practice {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} table, + your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice). You use these force points to cast {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}. You regain all expended force points when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Max Power Level
entries: Many {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} can be overpowered, consuming more force points to create a greater effect. You can overpower these abilities to a maximum level, which increases at higher levels, as shown in the Max Power Level column of the Beguiler Practice {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} table.
You may only cast {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} at 4th-level once. You regain the ability to do so after a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Forcecasting Ability
entries: Your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} varies based on the alignment of the powers you cast. You use your Wisdom for {@book light side powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, Charisma for {@book dark side powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, and Wisdom or Charisma for {@book universal powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} (your choice). You use this ability whenever a power refers to your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability}. Additionally, you use this ability modifier when setting the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} DC for a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} you cast and when making an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} with one.
{@b Force save DC} = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} modifier
{@b Force attack modifier} = your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} modifier

subclassFeature.name: Fascinating Display
entries: You can spend 1 minute attemping to distract and enthrall those around you. Choose a number of humanoids within 60 feet of you who watched your display for the duration, up to a number equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one). Each target must succeed on a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Charisma modifier) or be {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} by you. While {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} in this way, the target idolizes you, speaking glowingly of you to anyone who talks to it. Additionally, it hinders anyone who opposes you, although it avoids violence unless it was already inclined to fight on your behalf. This effect ends on a target after 1 hour, if it takes any damage, if you attack it, or if it witnesses you attacking or damaging any of its allies. If a target succeeds on this {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, the target has no hint you tried to charm it.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

subclassFeature.name: Mesmerizing Presence
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against creatures {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} by you.

subclassFeature.name: Enthralling Vigor
entries: Whenever a creature fails a Wisdom or Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} or class feature you use, you can gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to half your operative level + your Charisma modifier (minimum of +1).
You can use this feature five times. You gain an additional use at 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Distracting Countenance
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can mask yourself with the Force for 1 minute or until you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb}. For the duration, whenever any creature tries to attack you for the first time on a turn, the attacker must make a Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Charisma modifier). On a failed save, it can't attack you on this turn, and it must choose a new target for its attack or the attack is wasted. On a successful save, it can attack you on this turn, but it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on any {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} it makes against your powers on your next turn.

subclassFeature.name: Lethality Practice
entries: Those operatives who choose the Lethality Practice hone their skills in the art of death. They use precise and surprising attacks to dispatch their foes with fatal efficiency.

subclassFeature.name: Assassinate
entries: When you hit a creature that you are hidden from with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can choose to turn that hit into a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit}. If the attack reduces the creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, it does not automatically reveal your presence to any remaining creatures. Make a Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb}) check contested by the creatures' Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) check. On a success, you remain hidden. If you would already be able to make a Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb}) check to remain hidden as part of the attack, you instead gain {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the check.
You can use this feature once. You gain an additional use at 9th and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Lethal Strikes
entries: You learn how to read your foes and strikes their weak points. When you deal Sneak Attack damage to a creature, you may choose to forgo two of your Sneak Attack dice to make the attack a lethal strike.

Some of your lethal strikes require your target to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist the lethal strike's effects. The {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} DC is calculated as follows:
{@b Lethal Strike save DC} = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Dexterity modifier

entries.name: Priming Attack
entries: You attempt to prime the target. The target must make a Dexterity, Constitution, or Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (your choice). On a failed save, the next time you deal Sneak Attack damage against the target before the end of your next turn, you roll four additional Sneak Attack dice.

entries.name: Target Assessment
entries: You attempt to infer crucial details about your foe. The creature must make a Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, the GM tells you two of the following characteristics of your choice:

items: Highest ability score
Lowest ability score
Strongest {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}
Weakest {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}

entries.name: Vulnerable Strike
entries: You attempt to stagger the target. The target must make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.
